bbconemidlands.uk.title: Shrek Forever After
bbconemidlands.uk.description: Animated fantasy comedy, the fourth adventure about the grumpy, green ogre, featuring the voices of Mike Myers, Cameron Diaz and Eddie Murphy. Bored with his new-found domesticity, Shrek makes a deal with Rumpelstiltskin that will allow him to return to something like his old life. Things don't go to plan, however, when Shrek finds himself in a land where ogres are hunted and he and Princess Fiona have never met.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Kingdom
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E5 Olin's Last Chance The lion pride have grown stronger than ever, and the wild dogs have dwindled. Leopard Mutima returns home, while her ageing mother Olimba must overcome injury if she is to succeed in one final challenge. A new hyena queen rises from chaos, but can she regain ground from the lions? Even the powerful lion pride are under threat, especially when crossing Nsefu's crocodile-ridden waters.

Joe joins volunteers tackling litter and discovers efforts to protect rare alpine plants and the elusive Snowdon beetle, while Charlotte goes behind the scenes at Wales' highest cafe. Plus, Tom Heap investigates how organised crime gangs are targeting the countryside.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Reluctant Vampire
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E3 Leading a double life is proving tricky for Val. He's spending more time in the human village, and his friendship with Gertie is growing but so are Vernon's suspicions. When Victor admits to losing the castle in a card game to his nemesis Alexis, Val realises he needs to be in two places at once to keep both his friends and family happy.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Strictly Come Dancing: The Results
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S24 E8 Week 4 2026 Results Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe present as the two lowest-scoring couples go head to head in the dance-off. Plus, in honour of Icons Week, the professionals strike a pose as they delve into the back catalogue of queen of pop Madonna for their latest group number.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Antiques Roadshow
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S49 E6 Valentines Mansion & Gardens 2 Fiona Bruce returns to Valentines Mansion in East London, where finds include rare French buttons, a futuristic coffee set, wrestling memorabilia and props from Indiana Jones. She also explores Ilford's pioneering contribution to the history of photography, while Runjeet Singh challenges her to guess what three mystery Indian items were originally used for.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Time
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S3 E3 The possibility of romance and an opportunity at work make Bailey question his choices, and he turns to Marie-Louise in a moment of need. She receives the sign she hss been waiting for, but debates whether she is able to take a risk. Meanwhile, new evidence complicates loyalties between Peter and his friends, driving tensions higher, and James confronts his fears.

Leeds and the Red Devils drew 1-1 in last season's corresponding fixture, before the Whites prevailed 2-1 at Old Trafford. Plus, Bournemouth v Sunderland and Nottingham Forest v Arsenal.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Children of Men
bbconemidlands.uk.description: Futuristic thriller starring Clive Owen, Julianne Moore and Michael Caine. In 2027, humanity is facing inevitable extinction due to 18 years of infertility and Britain has become a quasi-fascist state. A ray of hope arrives with the discovery of a young woman who is pregnant, but can she be protected from a political group that wants to use her to further its own ends.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Graham Norton Show

There's also an appearance from Colin Farrell talking about new documentary The Slightest Touch, about skin-disease campaigner Emma Fogarty. bbconemidlands.uk.description: S16 E11 Too Hot to Handle? Sarah Moore risks getting her fingers burnt trying to turn candles into cash - and opts for multi-coloured carrot designs to save the day. Narrated by Arthur Smith.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Shift the Thrift
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E9 Chepstow Joanna Page heads to the border town of Chepstow, where medieval streets, independent shops and a strong charity shop scene set the stage for friends Ella and Issy as they race to turn charity shop finds into profit, taking bold risks on furniture and fashion before a tense live-streamed auction.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Escape to the Country
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S27 E29 South Devon Denise Nurse helps Susi, Sam and Rupert the dog leave busy Bedfordshire behind for south Devon, with £500,000 to find an annexe, more space and perhaps even a sea view.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Bidding Room
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S8 E13 1970s Diorama, 1950s Halifax Studio Light, 1930s Sporting Goods Five more sellers enter the room. There's a battle for sporting goods, two giant posters need a new home, and a retro piece prompts a charity auction like no other.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Bridge of Lies
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S5 E22 An intrepid family of four competes for cash by crossing a bridge of stepping stones across the studio floor. Quiz show, hosted by Ross Kemp.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Pointless
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S30 E30 Quiz show in which five pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Andi Oliver.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: BBC News at Six; Weather
bbconemidlands.uk.description: 19/10/2026 The latest headlines.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The One Show
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S2026 19/10/2026 Alex Jones and Roman Kemp host the first visit of the week to the One Show studio, featuring the usual mix of topical stories and celebrity chat.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: EastEnders
bbconemidlands.uk.description: E7419 19/10/2026 Kat remains determined to find the man she believes let Zoe die. After tracking down the former owner of Charlie's cab, she and Alfie are disappointed to learn he has already been cleared by police. Refusing to give up, Kat vows to get justice. Meanwhile, Cindy returns from her honeymoon, but she's not alone.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Big Housing Rip Off - Panorama
bbconemidlands.uk.description: 19/10/2026 In-depth current affairs report covering a story behind the headlines.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Clickbait Clinic with Stacey Dooley
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E5 Can Blue Dye Make Me Smarter? Stacey explores a trend that has racked up over 200 million online views worldwide - the use of a textile dye that influencers claim can boost brain power and gained worldwide notoriety when US health secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr appeared to put drops of it in his drink. Stacey conducts a test to find out if it might work, and shocks the doctors in the lab with online deepfakes created to get them to promote new trends.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Death in Paradise
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S12 E2 The team investigates a survivalist commune when one of its members is poisoned inside a locked bunker. However, with CCTV footage showing that no one went in or came out while he was in there, it seems likely that he has taken his own life - or has he? Meanwhile, Neville has a series of adventurous dates with Sophie. Robert Webb guest stars.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: BBC News at Ten
bbconemidlands.uk.description: 19/10/2026 A round-up of today's headlines.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Have I Got News for You
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S72 E3 Jason Manford hosts as guest panellists Zoe Lyons and Janet Street-Porter joins team captains Ian Hislop and Paul Merton for a satirical look at the news.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Yesterday
bbconemidlands.uk.description: Fantasy comedy starring Himesh Patel and Lily James. Cycling home after a gig, aspiring musician Jack is hit by a bus during a strange power cut. He wakes up to find himself in a world where nobody has heard of the Beatles, so takes advantage of this by passing their songs off as his own. Success soon comes his way, but it threatens to come between him and his manager and best friend, Ellie.

utv.uk.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland - Donegal Town
utv.uk.description: In Donegal Town, Dermot's journey takes him further south along the Wild Atlantic Way, discovering a place where Irish tradition and global flavours sit side by side. His day begins at family-run Hannah Hats, where he's fitted in iconic Donegal tweed and learns why this rugged corner of Ireland became famous for its beautifully flecked fabric. Dressed fit for a fine meal, Dermot visits one of Ireland's most unexpected culinary hotspots: Chandpur, widely regarded as Ireland's best curry house. He meets Bangladeshi-born chef Rana, and together they cook railway curry using outstanding local Donegal lamb and potatoes - it's a heaven-made match of Asian flavours and quality Irish produce. For pudding, Dermot meets chef Brian McDermott, one of the biggest champions of Donegal's food scene. Together they bake a classic Irish apple pie, with Brian revealing why all the local rain creates richer grass, creamier milk and extra buttery pastry, making Donegal Town a dessert destination. - 2024

utv.uk.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home - Saturday 17 Oct

There's a great green speedy garden herb dip, crowd-pleasing chocolate beef chilli that's next-level delicious and a showstopping French classic tarte Tatin using a Clodagh favourite shortcut, shop-bought puff pastry. There are cocktails and an impressive table setting mixing vegetables and flowers, both perfect for Clodagh's fun get-together. Her guests include her husband Harry Herbert, stepchildren Chloe and Will Herbert, her sister Mairead Hughes along with her children Jack and Ciara, and Clodagh's friends Charles and Pandora Delevingne, Ben Brown, Louisa Guinness and Jamie Loughborough. - 2026

utv.uk.title: Tomorrow Never Dies - Tomorrow Never Dies
utv.uk.description: The 18th entry in the James Bond film series. Media tycoon Elliot Carver is one of the most powerful men in the world - his newspaper Tomorrow is a world leader in that industry, and he is about to launch a satellite network to capitalise on his success. However, he is hungry for more business - especially from the Asian market - and when a British Royal Navy ship is mysteriously sunk in the South China Sea by unknown means and any survivors of the attack are killed afterwards, Tomorrow manages to be first to tell the world that the survivors' bodies were riddled with Chinese bullets. China repeatedly denies any responsibility for the attack, but Admiral Roebuck of the Royal Navy insists that China are to blame. However, M - the venerable boss of MI6 - suspects that there is more to the attack and therefore sends James Bond on a mission to find the real cause behind the sinking of the British ship. utv.uk.description: The first part of a two-part series following detectives as they reinvestigate the murder of Carol Morgan in the storeroom of her Bedfordshire corner shop in 1991 - a beloved local figure and mother of two young children, the murder had haunted the community ever since. Filmed over six years with full access to the police investigation, the programme follows the detectives as they bring one of the most intractable murder cases from the past to justice. The detectives re-examine the files, revisit the crime scene, and look for new witnesses - the original theory was that this was a robbery gone wrong, but were there clues that the original investigation had missed and was there a motive that was overlooked? Two suspects are identified and brought in for questioning - can they uncover what really happened to Carol. (Crime, Documentary) - 2025

utv.uk.title: The Real Unforgotten - The Real Unforgotten Part 2

The detectives unravel long-forgotten secrets and have a potential circumstantial case against two suspects, but they need more to prove their case in court - fortunately, they get a breakthrough after an appeal for new witnesses as two people come forward and one of them has testimony that changes everything. Can the detectives finally uncover what really happened to Carol - and expose a dark lie that has lay hidden for four decades - and do they have enough to convince a jury. (Crime, Documentary) - 2025

itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E8 Donegal Town Dermot reaches Donegal Town, discovering a place where Irish tradition and global flavours sit side by side. His day begins at family-run Hannah Hats, where he's fitted in iconic Donegal tweed and learns why this rugged corner of Ireland became famous for its flecked fabric. He visits Chandpur, widely regarded as Ireland's best curry house, where he and Bangladeshi-born chef Rana cook railway curry using outstanding local lamb and potatoes. For pudding, Dermot bakes a classic Irish apple pie with chef Brian McDermott, who explain how the rain improves local produce.

bet.us.title: The Perfect Guy
bet.us.description: With a fulfilling career and a loving relationship, lobbyist Leah Vaughn (Sanaa Lathan) seems to have it all. Things come crashing down when Dave, her long-term boyfriend, questions her future plans for marriage and a family. The resulting breakup leaves Leah heartbroken, until she meets the charming and handsome Carter Duncan (Michael Ealy). Soon, the budding romance turns dangerous as Carter reveals his volatile nature, forcing Leah to turn the tables on the man she thought was Mr. Right. (Thriller) - 2015

bet.us.title: Ma
bet.us.description: A lonely middle-aged woman befriends some teenagers and decides to let them party in the basement of her home. But there are some house rules: One of the kids has to stay sober, don't curse, and never go upstairs. They must also refer to her as Ma. But as Ma's hospitality starts to curdle into obsession, what began as a teenage dream turns into a terrorizing nightmare, and Ma's place goes from the best place in town to the worst place on Earth. (Thriller, Horror, Mystery) - 2019

bet.us.title: Obsessed
bet.us.description: Things couldn't be better for Derek Charles (Idris Elba). He's just received a big promotion at work, and has a wonderful marriage with his beautiful wife, Sharon (Beyoncé Knowles). However, into this idyllic world steps Lisa (Ali Larter), a temporary worker at Derek's office. Lisa begins to stalk Derek, jeopardizing all he holds dear. (Thriller, Drama) - 2009

amc.us.title: Final Destination
amc.us.description: Alex Browning is embarking on a trip to Paris. He experiences a premonition -- he sees the plane explode moments after leaving the ground. Insisting that everyone get off the plane, Alex and seven other people are forced to disembark. All watch as the plane actually explodes in a fireball. He and the other survivors have briefly cheated death, but will not be able to evade their fate for very long. One by one, these fugitives from fate fall victim to the grim reaper. (Horror, Thriller) - 2000

amc.us.title: Final Destination 2
amc.us.description: Kimberly (A.J. Cook) has a premonition of a horrible highway accident killing multiple people -- including her and her friends. She blocks the cars behind her on the ramp from joining traffic -- and as a police trooper (Michael Landes) arrives, the accident actually happens. Now, Death is stalking this group of mistaken survivors -- and one by one they are dying as they were supposed to on the highway. (Horror, Thriller) - 2003

amc.us.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
amc.us.description: A year after running over a fisherman and dumping his body in the water, four friends reconvene when Julie (Jennifer Love Hewitt) receives a frightening letter telling her that their crime was seen. While pursuing who he thinks is responsible for the letter, Barry (Ryan Phillippe) is run over by a man with a meat hook. The bloodletting only increases from there, as the killer with the hook continues to stalk Julie, Helen (Sarah Michelle Gellar) and Ray (Freddie Prinze Jr.). (Horror, Thriller) - 1997

amc.us.title: The Final Destination
amc.us.description: While enjoying a day at the track, Nick O'Bannon (Bobby Campo) has a horrific premonition of his friends and him all dying in a freak accident involving many racecars. Mere seconds before the vision comes true, he manages to convince them to leave. Although they cheat death then, the survivors each begin to meet a grisly end, and Nick tries to figure a way to escape a similar fate. (Horror, Thriller) - 2009

amc.us.title: The Mist
amc.us.description: After a powerful storm damages their Maine home, David Drayton (Thomas Jane) and his young son head into town to gather food and supplies. Soon afterward, a thick fog rolls in and engulfs the town, trapping the Draytons and others in the grocery store. Terror mounts as deadly creatures reveal themselves outside, but that may be nothing compared to the threat within, where a zealot (Marcia Gay Harden) calls for a sacrifice. (Horror, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2007

amc.us.title: Friday the 13th - Part III
amc.us.description: The third installment in the "Friday the 13th" series picks up on the day after the carnage with homicidal maniac Jason Voorhees (Richard Brooker) stealing some clothes and killing a local store owner. Meanwhile, Chris (Dana Kimmell) and her sometimes boyfriend, Rick (Paul Kratka), are hosting a group of teenage friends at Chris' lake house. Despite a run-in with a local biker gang, they enjoy an amiable weekend together -- that is, until Jason begins knocking off kids and bikers alike. (Horror, Action, Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 1982

amc.us.title: Friday the 13th
amc.us.description: Crystal Lake's history of murder doesn't deter counselors from setting up a summer camp in the woodsy area. Superstitious locals warn against it, but the fresh-faced young people -- Jack (Kevin Bacon), Alice (Adrienne King), Bill (Harry Crosby), Marcie (Jeannine Taylor) and Ned (Mark Nelson) -- pay little heed to the old-timers. Then they find themselves stalked by a brutal killer. As they're slashed, shot and stabbed, the counselors struggle to stay alive against a merciless opponent. (Horror) - 1980

amc.us.title: Friday the 13th, Part 2
amc.us.description: The second entry in the long-running horror series focuses on a group of teenage would-be counselors converging on Camp Crystal Lake for training under the tutelage of head counselor Paul (John Furey). Inevitably, Paul relates the story of Jason Voorhees (Warrington Gillette), a boy who ostensibly drowned at the camp and whose mother murdered a group of counselors in revenge. No one takes the tale seriously until a very much alive Jason begins gruesomely eliminating people. (Horror, Action, Mystery, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1981

amc.us.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors
amc.us.description: During a hallucinatory incident, young Kristen Parker (Patricia Arquette) has her wrists slashed by dream-stalking monster Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund). Her mother, mistaking the wounds for a suicide attempt, sends Kristen to a psychiatric ward, where she joins a group of similarly troubled teens. One of the doctors there is Nancy Thompson (Heather Langenkamp), who had battled Freddy some years before. Nancy senses a potential in Kristen to rid the world of Freddy once and for all. (Horror) - 1987

amc.us.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 2: Freddy's Revenge
amc.us.description: Jesse Walsh (Mark Patton) moves with his family into the home of the lone survivor from a series of attacks by dream-stalking monster Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund). There, Jesse is bedeviled by nightmares and inexplicably violent impulses. It turns out Freddy needs a host body to carry out his gruesome vendetta against the youth of Springwood, Ohio. While Freddy gains influence, Jesse and his girlfriend, Lisa (Kim Myers), race against the clock trying to figure out what's going on. (Horror) - 1985

amc.us.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
amc.us.description: In Wes Craven's classic slasher film, several Midwestern teenagers fall prey to Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund), a disfigured midnight mangler who preys on the teenagers in their dreams -- which, in turn, kills them in reality. After investigating the phenomenon, Nancy (Heather Langenkamp) begins to suspect that a dark secret kept by her and her friends' parents may be the key to unraveling the mystery, but can Nancy and her boyfriend Glen (Johnny Depp) solve the puzzle before it's too late? (Horror, Thriller) - 1984

amc.us.title: Freddy vs. Jason
amc.us.description: Two horror icons face off in this supernatural movie. Disfigured serial killer Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund), who attacks his victims in their dreams, has lost much of his power since citizens of his town have become less afraid of him. Enlisting the help of fellow violent murderer Jason Voorhees (Ken Kirzinger), Freddy orchestrates a new killing spree. However, when the hockey-mask-wearing psychopath won't stop chopping up Freddy's intended victims, the two ghouls start to battle each other. (Horror) - 2003

amc.us.title: Tremors
amc.us.description: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: The Scooby-Doo Show - High Rise Hair Raiser
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: Fred, Shaggy and Scooby try to solve the mystery behind the appearance of a 180-year-old man at a construction site.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: The Scooby-Doo Show - The Fiesta Host Is an Aztec Ghost
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: The gang tries to solve the mysterious appearance of an ancient Aztec god who has caused the abandonment of the Cinco de Mayo festival in Mexico.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: Looney Tunes - The Windblown Hare
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: Bugs buys houses from the Three Little Pigs, not knowing the Big Bad Wolf is lurking nearby.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: Looney Tunes - Fast and Furry-ous
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: Wile E. Coyote tries to use a boomerang, a fake tunnel and a boulder to catch the Road Runner.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: Looney Tunes - Dough For The Do-Do / An Egg-Scramble
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: DOUGH FOR THE DO-DO--Porky goes to Wackyland to hunt the Dodo bird. Of course the Dodo bird outsmarts the pig and creates a lot of problems for him.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: Tom & Jerry - Scared Bear
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: Droopy and Barney Bear seek shelter in an old house during a rainstorm; they soon find themselves unable to leave the building, which appears to be abandoned.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: The Tom and Jerry Comedy Show - School for Cats
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: Tom's master enrolls the cat in a special school to improve feline skills; Tom soon discovers he is in big trouble when Jerry takes over the class on mouse-catching.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: Tom & Jerry - Shutter Bugged Cat
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: Frustrated by his inability to catch Jerry to date, Tom builds a mousetrap.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: Teen Titans Go! - We're Off to Get Awards
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: During an awards ceremony, Robin is swept up by a tornado and arrives in a magical land.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: Teen Titans Go! - Bat Scouts
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: To reach the highest rank in the Bat Scouts, Robin teaches the other Titans important vigilante skills.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: Teen Titans Go! - Walk Away
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: After the T-Car is destroyed in a fight, the Titans go to a used car lot to find a replacement.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: Teen Titans Go! - Record Book
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: Starfire wants a world record, so she decides to grow her fingernails.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - The Detective
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: Anais believes Gumball and Darwin stole Daisy.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - The Fury
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: The kids are surprised that Nicole doesn't fight back when insulted by a strange figure.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - The Stories
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: The boys instruct Molly on how to make her stories more exciting.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - The Compilation
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: Funny and bizarre clips uploaded to the Internet by the people of Elmore.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - The Disaster
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: When Rob purchases a universal remote from the Awesome Store, he discovers he can control the entire universe; he rewinds into the past and remembers Gumball had left him.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - The Re-Run
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: Gumball hits rewind on Rob's Universal Remote just in time to save himself from being trapped in The Void.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - The Guy
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: Gumball and Darwin put Anais' new friend, Josh, through a series of tests to see if he's good enough for their sister.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - The Boredom
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: Gumball and Darwin are convinced it's one of those days when nothing interesting is happening; as they walk around Elmore in search of adventure, it becomes apparent exciting things are happening just not to them.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: Regular Show - Caveman
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: Mordecai and Rigby try to civilize a caveman so he will be allowed to stay in the park.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: Regular Show - That's My Television
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: Mordecai and Rigby help their favorite '80s sitcom star escape to the mountains.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: Regular Show - A Bunch of Full Grown Geese
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: Mordecai and Rigby must rid the park of troublesome geese.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: Regular Show: The Lost Tapes - Party Horse 4: Third Time's a Charm
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: The guys call an old friend to get the party started.

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: The Grim Adventures of Billy and Mandy - Nursery Crimes; My Peeps
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: Billy demands fairy tales from Grim and Mandy when he cannot sleep; Billy loses his sight when he sits too close to the television. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2004-07-09

cartoonnetworkwest.us.title: The Grim Adventures of Billy and Mandy - Bully Boogie; Here Thar Be Dwarves
cartoonnetworkwest.us.description: The Boogie Man competes with Grim for his job; Billy resolves a dispute between Dwarves and Elves. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2004-07-23

espnnews.us.description: Six World League FlingGolf stars battle it out to see who has mastered their FlingStick. (Sports, Golf)

espnnews.us.description: International darts competition. (Sports, Darts)

espnnews.us.description: Watch the Great American Events. (Sports, Miscellaneous)

fx.us.title: The Nightmare Before Christmas
fx.us.description: The film follows the misadventures of Jack Skellington, Halloweentown's beloved pumpkin king, who has become bored with the same annual routine of frightening people in the "real world." When Jack accidentally stumbles on Christmastown, all bright colors and warm spirits, he gets a new lease on life -- he plots to bring Christmas under his control by kidnapping Santa Claus and taking over the role. But Jack soon discovers even the best-laid plans of mice and skeleton men can go seriously awry. (Animated, Children, Holiday, Fantasy, Comedy) - 1993

fx.us.title: Ghostbusters
fx.us.description: After the members of a team of scientists (Harold Ramis, Dan Aykroyd, Bill Murray) lose their cushy positions at a university in New York City, they decide to become "ghostbusters" to wage a high-tech battle with the supernatural for money. They stumble upon a gateway to another dimension, a doorway that will release evil upon the city. The Ghostbusters must now save New York from complete destruction. (Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure) - 1984

fx.us.title: Ghostbusters II
fx.us.description: After saving New York City from a ghost attack, the Ghostbusters -- a team of spirit exterminators -- is disbanded for demolishing parts of the city during the battle. But when Ghostbuster Peter Venkman learns that spirits have taken an interest in his son, the men launch a rogue ghost-chasing mission. The quest quickly goes awry, landing them in court. But when the ghosts turn on the judge, he issues an order allowing the Ghostbusters to get back to work. (Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure) - 1989

fx.us.title: Aliens
fx.us.description: After floating in space for 57 years, Lt. Ripley's shuttle is found by a deep space salvage team. Upon arriving at LV-426, the marines find only one survivor, a nine-year-old girl named Newt. But even these battle-hardened marines with all the latest weaponry are no match for the hundreds of aliens that have invaded the colony. (Science fiction, Horror, Action, Adventure) - 1986

fx.us.title: Prometheus
fx.us.description: The discovery of a clue to mankind's origins on Earth leads a team of explorers to the darkest parts of the universe. Two brilliant young scientists lead the expedition. Shaw hopes that they will meet a race of benevolent, godlike beings who will in some way verify her religious beliefs, while Holloway is out to debunk any spiritual notions. However, neither the scientists nor their shipmates are prepared for the unimaginable terrors that await them. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller) - 2012

fx.us.title: Independence Day
fx.us.description: In the epic adventure film "Independence Day," strange phenomena surface around the globe. The skies ignite. Terror races through the world's major cities. As these extraordinary events unfold, it becomes increasingly clear that a force of incredible magnitude has arrived; its mission: total annihilation over the Fourth of July weekend. The last hope to stop the destruction is an unlikely group of people united by fate and unimaginable circumstances. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action) - 1996

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Salvage Dawgs - Salvaging Items in Norfolk and Petersburg Into Repurposed Goods
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: Robert and Grayson salvage a spiral staircase in Norfolk, while Mike and the crew tackle a restoration shop in Petersburg.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Salvage Dawgs - Salvaging Items From a High School Into Purposed Goods
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: The crew saves parts from a 1917 high school up in Youngwood, Pa.; Mike builds a coffee table from horse tack.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Barnwood Builders - The Johnny Jett Special
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: The Barnwood Builders honor machinist, artist and craftsman Johnny Jett; a highlight of Johnny's most unforgettable moments as well as previously unaired footage featuring West Virginia's favorite Renaissance man.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Fixer Upper - All-American Farmhouse
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: A wounded veteran and his girlfriend call on Chip and Jo to help them convert their house in Waco into a dreamy farmhouse; while the land is beautiful and majestic, the house is small and built inside an existing barn.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Fixer Upper: Welcome Home - Minty Green Flipper Upper
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: Chip purchases a minty green house on a whim with plans to flip it, but the daunting look of the interior and unexpected damage inside the home turns out to be more work than he and Jo expected.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Fixer Upper - Rustic Italian Dream Home
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: Jenny and Ramil are moving to Waco, Texas, from California to be closer to Ramil's mother; they are looking for something that needs work despite initial concerns.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Fixer Upper - Touchdown for a Family in Need
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: Chip and Joanna team up with Tim Tebow and his foundation to create a wheelchair accessible home for the Copp Family.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Lobster Shack Scramble
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: For Ted Wiederhorn, a cabin on the ocean front was a dream he always had; with his wish granted after purchasing an abandoned lobster shack on a peninsula, it's up to the Cabin Masters to get this shack running again.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - A Cabin for the Whole Family
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: It is a great opportunity for Chase and the team to rebuild and ultimately repair a cabin for a man and his family, but they will have to act quickly so they can finish before winter arrives so that the family can enjoy it for years to come.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - A Family Cabin Reclaimed
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: A family that has owned land in Maine for over 100 years repurchases land they previously sold and calls on the Cabin Masters to refurbish an abandoned property; the team creates a new bathroom, bedroom and yoga space and add landscaping outside.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - A Home for the Cabin Masters
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: The team jumps at the opportunity to buy a friend's 100-year-old farmhouse in Manchester, Maine, and transform it into their headquarters; they plan to create a showroom, offices and a special space for designing and creating custom pieces.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Two Bathrooms, No Bedrooms
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: After purchasing land in 2006, a man set out to construct a cabin within 72 hours, the resulting camp is lacking bedrooms, so the Cabin Masters create a main bedroom, sleeping areas and separate bathrooms.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Keeping the Dreams Alive
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: The team has their hands full as they navigate a treacherous hillside to stabilize a camp and restore it, so a family can continue to enjoy it for at least another 42 years.

magnolianetworkwest.us.title: Maine Cabin Masters - Peace, Love and a Fallen Pine Tree
magnolianetworkwest.us.description: A winter storm and a fallen tree jeopardize to destroy a family's Bear Pond property; Chase and the Cabin Masters come to the rescue, preserving the camp's oddities and adding space for the soon-arriving next generation. motortrend.us.title: Hot Rod Garage - Modern Turbo Tech
motortrend.us.description: Tony and Lucky bring a 1986 Ford Thunderbird Turbo Coupe into the 21st century by adding new turbo technology and a modern computer system; they'll see if the 2.3 L Pinto engine can hang with its recent EcoBoost descendant. (Auto) - 2020-06-12

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - How Do You Say Bitchin' in Italian?
motortrend.us.description: Good things come in small packages, and this 1967 Fiat fits the bill; Dave is excited by a new challenge; the build sheet includes making it a wide body, a more powerful engine, custom fender flares and more. (Reality, Auto) - 2023-10-03

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - We've Gone Plaid
motortrend.us.description: A loyal Kindig-It client has decided to jump on the latest trend -- he wants Dave to build him a show-off, off-road vehicle; after they get past the rust repair, it'll be new fender flares, engine and custom chassis for this 1974 Bronco. (Reality, Auto) - 2023-10-10

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - A Bitchin' Off-Road Warrior
motortrend.us.description: The Bronco's owner is lukewarm on Dave's radical idea for the interior; Dave must resist going too far with this build so they can actually enjoy it on dirt roads without feeling like they're beating up a museum piece. (Reality, Auto) - 2023-10-10

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - New Engine, New Headache
motortrend.us.description: Dave Kindig, owner and operator of Kindig-It Design, turns out one-of-a-kind vehicles for his demanding (and sometimes famous) clientele. Working on all types and periods of cars, we'll see cars rendered, designed, built and restored from the ground up. (Reality, Auto) - 2023-10-17

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - A Whole New Game
motortrend.us.description: Dave is interested in dipping his feet in the electric car world; with his CF1s providing the canvas, he decides to take the plunge; turning this into reality needs a new level of engineering and learning a new automotive language. (Reality, Auto) - 2023-10-17

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Benefit for the Basin
motortrend.us.description: Dave has a soft spot for all kids in need; so when a car show in Oregon that benefits the local children's charity called, Dave eagerly said yes; the guys take the rig to the show; there's a rumor that Kev may actually get a spot in the drag races. (Reality, Auto) - 2023-10-24

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - I Love It
motortrend.us.description: One of KevDogg's favorite cars has arrived in the form of a stock post Bel Air, and he will lead the charge on the build; when Kev's pride and joy takes a turn for the worse, he enlists the help of a local dealer to help him get back on the road. (Reality, Auto) - 2023-10-24

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Kevin Hart's Challenger
motortrend.us.description: Entertainer and car collector Kevin Hart's latest project is in the shop, and every square inch of the car is getting customized, from a futuristic front and rear end redesign to subtle but huge changes to the rear window and fenders. (Reality, Auto) - 2023-10-31

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - I Hart Challengers
motortrend.us.description: The fabrication for Kevin Hart's Challenger is complete, and now Dave is taking his futuristic theme into the dash and interior; a new custom color, flawless body work and seamless assembly are in store for this client who expects perfection.

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - No Regrets
motortrend.us.description: In high school, Dave's wife Charity drove the wheels off her '67 Chevelle; when the couple started their business, they sold the car with the hopes of one day getting another; the crew works to get it ready.

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Benefit for the Basin
motortrend.us.description: Dave has a soft spot for all kids in need; so when a car show in Oregon that benefits the local children's charity called, Dave eagerly said yes; the guys take the rig to the show; there's a rumor that Kev may actually get a spot in the drag races.

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Mueller?? Mueller??
motortrend.us.description: Of all the different years and generations of the VW Bug, there is one that stands out among the rest -- the Hebmüller; there are maybe 200 of them left, so in addition to being hard to find, they are truly the holy grail of VWs.

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - The Holy Grail, but Customized
motortrend.us.description: The build continues, and the challenge is to keep what makes the car a Hebmueller intact, while taking steps to turn it into a hot rod; Dave keeps the traditional two-tone exterior, but modifying it to an automatic is a challenge for the shop.

motortrend.us.title: Bitchin' Rides - Meet Judge KevDogg
motortrend.us.description: Normally when Kindig-It Design attends a car show, their cars are the ones being judged; this time around, Dave and Kev hold the keys and have to select the top 10 builders out of the hundreds of cars that arrive for the show.

motortrend.us.title: Junkyard Empire - British Catastrophe
motortrend.us.description: When Bobby Cohen spots a rusty British Cab at the junkyard, he vows to do what he can to save it; his son, Andy, thinks he's crazy and makes a big investment in a high dollar Lamborghini Murcielago to recoup the money he worries Bobby will lose.

motortrend.us.title: Junkyard Empire - Wired for Speed
motortrend.us.description: When Andy finally scores the only wire harness in the country that can marry his SVO Mustang to a new EcoBoost engine, he pressures Blair to bring it to life; George cuts an F350 in half to create the first single cab short bed diesel pick-up truck.

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - Camaro Frankenstein
motortrend.us.description: A 1989 Camaro turns out to be anything but what it seems.

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - Seeing Double
motortrend.us.description: Two workhorse Chevy beasts need a lot of work to get on their feet.

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - Malibu Mayhem
motortrend.us.description: After an American hero loses his battle with PTSD, the Squad teams up with his father to restore the 1968 Chevrolet Malibu his son bought on eBay while deployed in Iraq.

motortrend.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Bel Air Big Block and Street Legal Restomod
motortrend.us.description: A '57 Chevy looks great, but the guys discover that looks can be deceiving.

motortrend.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Bel Air Big Block Part 2
motortrend.us.description: Joe Martin puts the finishing touches on the 1957 Chevrolet Bel Air and arranges for the car to be delivered to the owner; Joe uses all his tricks to prepare a Chevrolet C10 for a charity auction with a stylish paint job.

motortrend.us.title: Iron Resurrection - '51 Chevy: Rad Red Christmas Truck
motortrend.us.description: It's beginning to look a lot like Christmas as Joe and his crew tackle a unique request: turn a salvaged red '51 Chevy 3100 pickup into a roadworthy, Christmas-parade spectacle; Joe devises a plan for bigger power, an updated suspension and more.

motortrend.us.title: Iron Resurrection - '51 Chevy: Rad Red Christmas Truck Part 2
motortrend.us.description: Custom car guru Joe Martin and his team at Martin Bros. Customs put the final touches on a red 1951 Chevy 3100 pickup, transforming it a Christmas parade truck.

motortrend.us.title: Iron Resurrection - '65 Pontiac: Cool Catalina
motortrend.us.description: Joe dusts off his prized '65 Pontiac Catalina to give it the facelift it deserves; new brakes, new trick frame and a bigger, badder LSA 600 horsepower motor; Martin Bros. Customs tricks out the interior on a 1932 Ford Roadster.

motortrend.us.title: Iron Resurrection - '65 Pontiac: Cool Catalina Part 2
motortrend.us.description: With updates well underway on custom car guru Joe Martin's prized '65 Pontiac Catalina, Joe and the boys at Martin Bros. Customs give the ol' choppy-doo to a '41 DeSoto that has seen better days.

motortrend.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Rebuild: Supercharged '66 Nova
motortrend.us.description: A longtime customer has his eye set on a car from Joe's personal collection, a 1967 Nova; Joe counters by offering up a 1966 Nova, with the guarantee that it will be twice the car Joe's is; big brakes, big power, big wheels and more. (Reality, Auto, Motorcycle) - 2022-11-10

mtv2west.us.title: The Jamie Foxx Show - Convent-ional Gifts
mtv2west.us.description: Jamie accidentally switches a sexy gag gift for Braxton with a religious statue intended for a parochial schoolteacher. (Sitcom) - 1998-02-01

mtv2west.us.title: The Jamie Foxx Show - Passenger 187
mtv2west.us.description: Jamie and Braxton (Jamie Foxx, Christopher B. Duncan) must land a plane after a medical emergency sidelines the aircraft's pilot. (Sitcom) - 1998-02-08

mtv2west.us.title: The Jamie Foxx Show - Ain't Nothin' Happenin' Cap'n
mtv2west.us.description: Fancy finally accepts Jamie's advances, leaving him shocked; Braxton employs pop psychology in an effort to understand women. (Sitcom) - 1998-02-15

mtv2west.us.title: The Jamie Foxx Show - It's All Good, Fellas
mtv2west.us.description: Jamie (Jamie Foxx) saves the life of a mobster (guest star Eddie Mekka), who then lavishes him with gifts. (Sitcom) - 1998-02-22

mtv2west.us.title: The Jamie Foxx Show - You Ain't Gotta Go Home, But ...
mtv2west.us.description: Jamie is evicted from King's Tower after throwing one too many loud parties and ends up as Braxton's roommate. (Sitcom) - 1998-03-01

mtv2west.us.title: The Jamie Foxx Show - I'm Too Sexy for This Shot
mtv2west.us.description: Jamie seeks legal advice from a tough lawyer after revealing photos of Fancy turn up on the Internet. (Sitcom) - 1998-05-03

mtv2west.us.title: The Jamie Foxx Show - How Jamie Got His Groove
mtv2west.us.description: Jamie (Jamie Foxx) meets K-Ci & Jojo (guest starring as themselves) and gives them a copy of his demo tape on a chance for his big break. (Sitcom) - 1998-05-17

mtv2west.us.title: The Jamie Foxx Show - Jamie Returns
mtv2west.us.description: Jamie (Jamie Foxx) goes on tour, performing before thousands of fans; Fancy (Garcelle Beauvais) has a new boyfriend. (Sitcom) - 1998-09-17

mtv2west.us.title: The Jamie Foxx Show - Don't Hate the Player, Hate the Game
mtv2west.us.description: Jamie (Jamie Foxx) plots to have Fancy's (Garcelle Beauvais) new boyfriend, Silas (guest star Alan F. Smith), get caught in a compromising situation. (Sitcom) - 1998-09-24

mtv2west.us.title: The Jamie Foxx Show - MEN-O-pause
mtv2west.us.description: Junior (Garrett Morris) is chagrined when a slim Helen (Ellia English) starts getting attention from men. (Sitcom) - 1998-10-01

mtv2west.us.title: The Jamie Foxx Show - Swing Out Sister
mtv2west.us.description: Jamie's fortune-seeking sister may find the wrong kind of fame when she gets invited to a wild party. (Sitcom) - 1998-10-08

mtv2west.us.title: The Jamie Foxx Show - Is There a Doctor in the House?
mtv2west.us.description: Jamie (Jamie Foxx) takes Fancy (Garcelle Beauvais) to her 10-year high-school reunion after her boyfriend Silas (guest star Alan F. Smith) is delayed. (Sitcom) - 1998-10-15

mtv2west.us.title: The Jamie Foxx Show - Guess Who's Not Coming to Dinner
mtv2west.us.description: Braxton's (Christopher B. Duncan) secret relationship with Cameron (Susan Wood) causes trouble when an old flame (guest star Tembi Locke) comes to town. (Sitcom) - 1998-10-29

mtv2west.us.title: The Challenge - They Are Like Cockroaches
mtv2west.us.description: The challengers are sent on the heist of a century to collect a key using… haystacks. This exhausting challenge is a crucial look into everyone's speed and endurance, and one team's performance is shocking to everyone. (Competition reality, Entertainment) - 2025-10-22

mtv2west.us.title: The Challenge - We Have to Boogie!
mtv2west.us.description: As the numbers whittle down, everyone's collective performance in the challenge becomes crucial because winning or losing takes a vote away from their alliance; how important is your own safety versus your team's safety? (Competition reality, Entertainment) - 2025-10-29

mtv2west.us.title: The Challenge - The Best Birthday Present
mtv2west.us.description: In a challenge filled with chains, the players must trust their partner's driving skills to help them succeed; if you love rummaging through your junk drawer and unraveling cable, this elimination won't be one to miss. (Competition reality, Entertainment) - 2025-11-05

mtv2west.us.title: The Challenge - Am I Being Bamboozled?
mtv2west.us.description: The challengers must navigate a harrowing and pitch-black cave in hopes of earning safety; the teams in elimination must cram into a replica airplane bathroom, and it's not even close to the mile high club. (Competition reality, Entertainment) - 2025-11-12

mtv2west.us.title: The Challenge - Ten Toes Down
mtv2west.us.description: An argument creates tension in the house and reveals who's been playing honest and how devious the game can really be; a headbanger awaits the teams in elimination, and it's more than just their life in the game. (Competition reality, Entertainment) - 2025-11-19

mtv2west.us.title: The Challenge - Finale Part I
mtv2west.us.description: After a grueling season, the final four teams have made it to TJ's Final; while battling exhaustion, the players must complete grueling runs, mind-numbing checkpoints and the ultimate temptation to become Challenge Champions; that's only day one. (Competition reality, Entertainment) - 2025-11-26

mtv2west.us.title: Ink Master - The Ink Will Speak for Itself
mtv2west.us.description: Eighteen artists arrive ready to fight for themselves but instead find they must work in teams divided by gender; battle lines are drawn, then tested, in the "Ink Master" Battle of the Sexes; in the end, only one will win $100,000. (Art, Competition reality) - 2019-06-11

mtv2west.us.title: Ink Master - A Storm Is Brewin'
mtv2west.us.description: Team leaders emerge in a shocking new season-long twist that sends the Artists a wake-up call and shakes up the competition; The Battle of the Sexes continues for $100K and the title of Ink Master. (Art, Competition reality) - 2019-06-18

mtv2west.us.title: Ink Master - Down to the Wire
mtv2west.us.description: The artists must fight even harder to win the Battle of the Sexes as the field thins and the competition intensifies; one artist is not wired properly for the competition and must pack up and close shop. (Art, Competition reality) - 2019-06-25

mtv2west.us.title: Ink Master - The Hunter & the Hunted
mtv2west.us.description: The judges are looking for color contrast and the artists are out for blood with full color neo-traditional animal tattoos. (Art, Competition reality) - 2019-07-02

mtv2west.us.title: Ink Master - The Art Stands Alone
mtv2west.us.description: It's every man or woman for themselves when the artists are subject to a blind critique. (Art, Competition reality) - 2019-07-09

mtv2west.us.title: Ink Master - Art of War
mtv2west.us.description: The artists must put needle to skin consistently to take out their competitors; the battle of the sexes continues for $100K and the title of Ink Master. (Art, Competition reality) - 2019-07-16

mtv2west.us.title: Ink Master - Sabotage
mtv2west.us.description: The artists must prove their strength by facing off against each other. (Art, Competition reality) - 2019-07-23

mtv2west.us.title: Ink Master - Pins & No Needles
mtv2west.us.description: The judges test the artists' understanding of color theory; two coaches take the artists to school; the battle intensifies for $100K and the title of "Ink Master." (Art, Competition reality) - 2019-07-30

mtv2west.us.title: Ink Master - Drawing Alliances
mtv2west.us.description: The teams are out of balance as the artists cross enemy battle lines to pick secret alliances; a freehand drawing challenge tests the competitors' artistic ability. (Art, Competition reality) - 2019-08-06

mtv2west.us.title: Ink Master - By Accident or By Design
mtv2west.us.description: The battle for the grand prize and title of Ink Master continues as the judges test the artist's adaptability. (Art, Competition reality) - 2019-08-13

mtv2west.us.title: Ink Master - Roll of the Dice
mtv2west.us.description: The Artists find themselves in a dicey situation with confrontational coaches Josh Payne and Nikki Simpson.

mtv2west.us.title: Ink Master - Put Your Ink Where Your Mouth Is
mtv2west.us.description: The competition tests the artists' ability to market themselves when the power is in the hands of the canvases.

mtv2west.us.title: Ink Master - Moving Pictures
mtv2west.us.description: The artists are on their own in a test of finesse as the six remaining competitors fight for the cash prize and the title of Ink Master.

mtv2west.us.title: Ink Master - Unfriendly Fire
mtv2west.us.description: It's a battle of the sexes as the men's team takes aim at the women during an illustrative portrait challenge.

mtv2west.us.title: Ink Master - Step Up or Shut Up
mtv2west.us.description: The last four artists remaining battle it out in a tattoo marathon to secure their spot in the season finale.

mtv2west.us.title: Ink Master - Battle of the Sexes Finale
mtv2west.us.description: Seven veteran artists battle it out in the "Clash of the Coaches Face Off"; the battle of the sexes comes to an end as the three finalists reveal their 35-hour Master Canvas tattoos and one artist wins the title of Ink Master.

mtv2west.us.title: Auction Hunters - Battle Bought
mtv2west.us.description: A French "Harmonica Pistol" from the 1800s and combat robots from the 1990s.

mtv2west.us.title: Auction Hunters - Auction Hunter Shuffle
mtv2west.us.description: Ton and Allen teach a new auction hunter a lesson and find a 1940s shuffleboard and a hot rod made from part of a WWII fighter plane.

mtv2west.us.title: Auction Hunters - Allen's Ruff Day
mtv2west.us.description: Ton and Allen battle a big-mouthed buyer in Ton's hometown; tranquilizer dart guns; the guys fight with a K9.

mtv2west.us.title: Auction Hunters - Auction Hunters, Ink.
mtv2west.us.description: Allen and Ton score a 1960s autographed tattoo machine; Terry Ives competition chainsaw.

mtv2west.us.title: Auction Hunters - Bowling Pin Payday
mtv2west.us.description: The boys go head-to-head with a trash-talking auction buyer and uncover some treasures.

mtv2west.us.title: Auction Hunters - Beantown Bidders
mtv2west.us.description: 1800s whaling harpoon; 1940s tandem bicycle; vintage American flag collection.

mtv2west.us.title: Auction Hunters - Carolyn Goes Topless
mtv2west.us.description: A vicious battle erupts with former employee Carolyn over a 1968 Corvette Stingray; Allen tests his ninja skills.

mtv2west.us.title: Auction Hunters - Big Easy Money
mtv2west.us.description: Allen & Ton find more than easy money in New Orleans when they are challenged by some bayou bidders with money.

mtv2west.us.title: Auction Hunters - Choo-Choo Cha-Ching
mtv2west.us.description: Ton and Allen find a motorized railroad maintenance car from the 1960s and a pre-World War I Japanese semi-automatic pistol.

mtv2west.us.title: Auction Hunters - Cashville, Tennessee
mtv2west.us.description: Ton and Allen rumble with a band of high-bidding bikers; the guys discover a 37 millimeter anti-tank gun and a cowboy's rodeo saddle.

mtv2west.us.title: Teen Mom: Family Reunion - Couples Take Cartagena!
mtv2west.us.description: The teen moms and their partners travel to Cartagena, hosted by Cheyenne and Jade; couples are invited to a beachside resort to rekindle romance and face their issues with the help of professionals.

mtv2west.us.title: Teen Mom: Family Reunion - Get the Moan Out
mtv2west.us.description: Cast members from across the "Teen Mom" franchise come together for a tropical vacation; but it's not all rest and relaxation, as the moms dive deep into relationship, friendship and parenting issues.

mtv2west.us.title: Teen Mom: Family Reunion - Time to Get Naked!
mtv2west.us.description: Cast members from across the "Teen Mom" franchise come together for a tropical vacation; but it's not all rest and relaxation, as the moms dive deep into relationship, friendship and parenting issues.

mtv2west.us.title: Teen Mom: Family Reunion - In the Driver's Seat
mtv2west.us.description: Tensions rise as Mackenzie and her new boyfriend arrive at the villa; Mackenzie hopes to make amends with Cheyenne; a dune buggy drive leads the couples to a cathartic beach workshop.

mtv2west.us.title: Teen Mom: Family Reunion - Ice Ice Baby
mtv2west.us.description: The moms challenge the men in an obstacle course that leaves one of them injured; emotions run high for the women during a hypnosis workshop; a coaching session presses Cheyenne and Mackenzie to interact; a new arrival.

mtv2west.us.title: Teen Mom: Family Reunion - Rooftop Romance & Red Flags
mtv2west.us.description: Cheyenne and Mackenzie recover from a tense hypnosis session; the group lets loose during a party at a rooftop bar in Cartagena, but the fun fizzles when two couples clash.

mtv2west.us.title: Teen Mom: Family Reunion - Something's Fishy
mtv2west.us.description: A call from home ignites new conflict between Kayla and Ryan; Mack and Khes coordinate a family dinner that doesn't go as planned; Chey and Zach meet with Michaiah to discuss their fight the previous night.

mtv2west.us.title: Teen Mom: Family Reunion - Trouble Comes in Threes
mtv2west.us.description: The villa is jolted by the arrival of Kiaya, Briana and Leah, three single moms, who are looking to party; a personal watercraft accident sends Kiaya to the hospital; Leah causes drama when she lets loose.

mtv2west.us.title: Teen Mom: Family Reunion - Bride or Die
mtv2west.us.description: Leah's apology fails to ease tensions with Kiaya; Mack reveals a relationship fear to Khesanio; a celebration of Jade and Sean's upcoming nuptials leads to surprises and drama among friends.

mtv2west.us.title: The Hills - Stress and the City
mtv2west.us.description: Whitney and Lauren go to New York to present their ideas about the big fashion show; Franky tries to fix Brody and Spencer's friendship.

mtv2west.us.title: The Hills - Young Hollywood
mtv2west.us.description: Whitney is in charge of the Young Hollywood party; Heidi celebrates her birthday with Spencer; Audrina may have a new admirer.

mtv2west.us.title: The Hills - Forgive and Forget
mtv2west.us.description: Lauren runs into Heidi and they fight; Audrina and Justin struggle in their undefined relationship.

mtv2west.us.title: The Hills - With This Ring
mtv2west.us.description: Lauren plays matchmaker; Spencer resists Heidi's wedding plans which results in a fight. (Reality) - 2007-11-19

mtv2west.us.title: The Hills - A Night at the Opera
mtv2west.us.description: Andrea catches Justin kissing another girl; Spencer's sister Stephanie picks a fight with Lauren and Brody. (Reality) - 2007-11-26

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Payback
golfpass.us.description: A rush of national pride consumes the players as they tee it up in their first team, match-play competition to determine who's up for elimination, where it's distance control that determines an unlucky player's fate.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Sharpshooters Survive
golfpass.us.description: It's all about accuracy as the contestants test their approach shots and drive for more than just show to stay alive.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Flashback Fortunes
golfpass.us.description: Contestants experience déjà vu as they try to earn immunity from elimination, while an unfortunate few battle gusty winds and attempt to get a handle on distance control.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Steeped in Tradition
golfpass.us.description: Contestants take a surprise field trip to St. Andrews - the bastion of golf - and have to deal with the pressure as an unexpected gallery gathers to watch them perform.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Par or Better
golfpass.us.description: The golf course plays no favorites as both teams find out that sometimes it's not so easy to make par.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Shots on Demand
golfpass.us.description: An elimination challenge with a variety of shot results along with an emotional send-off.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Every Man for Himself
golfpass.us.description: The Europeans are faced with a no-win situation and scrap team unity for individual survival. Players get to choose the shot that just may end up proving their demise.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Bunker Down
golfpass.us.description: Nearly impossible bunker shots have the players trying to avoid making spectacles of themselves, while it's a one-on-one contest that determines who stays and who goes.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Pressure Points
golfpass.us.description: A contest designed for national bragging rights keeps the final USA and European contestants focused on team play.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Now or Never
golfpass.us.description: The remaining two Americans face nine holes of match play - as do their European counterparts - to determine who will play for the championship.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Who Will Be Champion
golfpass.us.description: National pride and lifelong dreams are at stake as the finalists representing the United States and Europe face off in the championship match.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Play or Pack
golfpass.us.description: Contestants are surprised to discover they must play their way onto the show, and one is sent home before her suitcase is unpacked.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Let the Matches Begin
golfpass.us.description: No time is wasted before contestants are pitted against one another in a match play competition to see who will be safe from elimination.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Choose Your Weapon
golfpass.us.description: Contestants pick a shot that could lead to immunity or, ultimately, send them home with nothing.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Team Unity
golfpass.us.description: Teammates rely on each other for points but, ultimately, face each other to see who will survive.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Beat the Pro
golfpass.us.description: Former LPGA stars Lori Kane and Beth Bauer challenge contestants to a one-of-a-kind, closest-to-the-pin contest.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Hit the Beach
golfpass.us.description: Contestants discover that sun and sand aren't the best combination for staying alive until the next show.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Trouble Shots
golfpass.us.description: Contestants are challenged to manage their way through a variety of trouble shots to keep their hopes alive.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Second Chances
golfpass.us.description: Contestants are surprised when someone might just be given a second chance to keep their dreams alive.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Turncoats
golfpass.us.description: Former teammates turn opponents in an Elimination Challenge that brings new meaning to "up and down.".

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Gimme a Break
golfpass.us.description: Contestants play golf's version of a favorite schoolyard basketball game and learn why pin-high can be the best shot.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Win and In
golfpass.us.description: The final four competitors square off in match play and one player makes the best of a second opportunity to avoid elimination.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Three's Company
golfpass.us.description: Tensions run high as the final three face several head-to-head challenges that narrow the field to two.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - The Grand Finale
golfpass.us.description: Contestants face off in the grand finale.

golfpass.us.title: Highway 18 - The Journey Begins
golfpass.us.description: After finding their car keys hidden within the thick walls of the Castillo de San Marcos in St. Augustine, Florida, the teams scurry to their first golf challenge at the World Golf Hall of Fame.

golfpass.us.title: Highway 18 - The Swamp
golfpass.us.description: It's a race against time and each other, as five teams of two find their way out of an alligator infested Florida swamp to the University of Florida football field for an unexpected chipping challenge.

golfpass.us.title: Highway 18 - Off to the Races
golfpass.us.description: The teams face an extraordinary "dogleg" tee shot around the first turn of an Ocala, Florida, horse track.

golfpass.us.title: Highway 18 - Beaches, Basketballs & Bunkers
golfpass.us.description: The players turn the world's most famous beach into the ultimate "bunker challenge" before rushing to the Orlando Magic practice facility for a full court putting contest.

golfpass.us.title: Highway 18 - The Spotlight
golfpass.us.description: Starting their day at the Golf Channel studios in Orlando, Florida, each team gets a shot at hosting a highlight package for the PODS Championship at Innisbrook Resort.

golfpass.us.title: Highway 18 - Golf History
golfpass.us.description: The teams vie for a set of antique clubs and race to Florida's first golf club for an old school short game challenge.

golfpass.us.title: Highway 18 - Long Drives
golfpass.us.description: Long Drive Champion Brian Pavlet helps tee things off at the Bobby Jones Golf Club in Sarasota, Florida.

golfpass.us.title: Highway 18 - Air Boats to Extravagance
golfpass.us.description: Each team must earn an airboat ride to their vehicle before racing to the Mar-a-Lago Club in West Palm.

golfpass.us.title: Highway 18 - Finding the Keys
golfpass.us.description: The action begins with a "Clubhouse Challenge" from Doral Golf Resort in Miami, Florida.

golfpass.us.title: Highway 18 - The Finish Line
golfpass.us.description: From Mallory Square to the renowned Key West party spot, Sloppy Joes, the action culminates on the southernmost golf course in America.

gameshowcentral.us.description: Contestants on this dating game show don't want to hear the elimination line "I'm sorry, but you have too much baggage." How much is acceptable among three contestants in each episode is determined by the "dater," who hears the candidates' intimate secrets and hidden flaws, as well as their attempts to deflect these traits by describing their positive attributes. After two elimination rounds leave one remaining contestant, it's the dater's turn to reveal his or her own baggage ... and then the contestant decides to go forward with the date or not. Jerry Springer hosts. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20100419

gameshowcentral.us.title: Mind of a Man
gameshowcentral.us.description: Women have been trying to answer the question of "what do men think" for years. "Mind of a Man" tries to help them figure out what is on the mind of the average guy. Each half-hour episode pits two female contestants against each other as they try to correctly answer questions asked of 100 men. Helping the women along the way is a rotating celebrity panel composed of a mix of men and women who offer opinions. The contestant who is more successful in understanding the mind of a man wins the game and advances to the bonus round, in which she can amass up to $10,000. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20140108

gameshowcentral.us.title: Divided
gameshowcentral.us.description: Veteran game show host and producer Mike Richards emcees this show that is described as "part game show, part social experiment." Four strangers must work as a team on each episode, coming to an agreement on the answer to each question Richards asks. They have to do it quickly, though, because as the clock ticks down so does the amount of money the contestants can win. So the longer they debate, the less a correct answer earns them. As the amount of money available increases in each round, the intensity ramps up as there is a point when the team must collectively decide on one member to eliminate. At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20161125

gameshowcentral.us.title: Emogenius
gameshowcentral.us.description: Emojis can be polarizing, with some people constantly using the little drawings and others not caring for them. Love 'em or hate 'em, emojis can be worth money on this comedic game show. Each half-hour episode pits two pairs of contestants against each other in a battle to see which team knows emojis better. The first challenge forces the contestants to decipher a series of pop culture-inspired emoji messages. In the second round, the contestants must send each other strings of emojis that their partners must correctly guess. The winning team then advances to the bonus round, in which the teammates trade off sending and guessing rapid-fire emoji messages. If they beat the bonus round, they take home $10,000. Social media star Hunter March hosts the show, and he has game show hosting in his blood -- grandfather Hal March served as emcee on "The $64,000 Question" in the 1950s. (Show, Series, Game show, Comedy) - 20170607

gameshowcentral.us.description: Contestants on this dating game show don't want to hear the elimination line "I'm sorry, but you have too much baggage." After two elimination rounds leave one remaining contestant, it's the dater's turn to reveal his or her own baggage ... and then the contestant decides to go forward with the date or not. Jerry Springer hosts. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20100419

gameshowcentral.us.title: Mind of a Man
gameshowcentral.us.description: Women have been trying to answer the question of "what do men think" for years. "Mind of a Man" tries to help them figure out what is on the mind of the average guy. Each half-hour episode pits two female contestants against each other as they try to correctly answer questions asked of 100 men. Helping the women along the way is a rotating celebrity panel composed of a mix of men and women who offer opinions. The contestant who is more successful in understanding the mind of a man wins the game and advances to the bonus round, in which she can amass up to $10,000. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20140108

gameshowcentral.us.title: Divided
gameshowcentral.us.description: Veteran game show host and producer Mike Richards emcees this show that is described as "part game show, part social experiment." Four strangers must work as a team on each episode, coming to an agreement on the answer to each question Richards asks. They have to do it quickly, though, because as the clock ticks down so does the amount of money the contestants can win. So the longer they debate, the less a correct answer earns them. As the amount of money available increases in each round, the intensity ramps up as there is a point when the team must collectively decide on one member to eliminate. At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20161125

gameshowcentral.us.title: Emogenius
gameshowcentral.us.description: Emojis can be polarizing, with some people constantly using the little drawings and others not caring for them. Love 'em or hate 'em, emojis can be worth money on this comedic game show. Each half-hour episode pits two pairs of contestants against each other in a battle to see which team knows emojis better. The first challenge forces the contestants to decipher a series of pop culture-inspired emoji messages. In the second round, the contestants must send each other strings of emojis that their partners must correctly guess. The winning team then advances to the bonus round, in which the teammates trade off sending and guessing rapid-fire emoji messages. If they beat the bonus round, they take home $10,000. Social media star Hunter March hosts the show, and he has game show hosting in his blood -- grandfather Hal March served as emcee on "The $64,000 Question" in the 1950s. (Show, Series, Game show, Comedy) - 20170607

wdafdt.us.title: Best Medicine
wdafdt.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. When Louis' son, Gage (Miko Hughes), dies tragically, Louis decides to bury the boy's body in the same ground despite the warnings of Crandall and Louis' visions of a deceased patient. Best Medicine
wtxfdt.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. 673498.title: The Great Sioux Massacre
673498.description: The story of Gen. Custer (Philip Carey) and the Little Bighorn is seen through the eyes of two of his subordinates (Joseph Cotten, Darren McGavin).

673498.title: Masterson of Kansas
673498.description: In the 1870s, Marshal Wyatt Earp (Bruce Cowling) calls upon Dodge City, Kan., Sheriff Bat Masterson (George Montgomery) to track down rancher Merrick (John Maxwell), who is accused of murder. But, thanks to some proof held by local Native American Chief Yellow Hawk (Jay Silverheels), Masterson realizes Merrick might be the victim of a frame-up. So, with the help of Earp and gunfighter Doc Holliday (James Griffith), Masterson sets out to find those who are really behind the killing.

673498.title: Massacre Canyon
673498.description: A cavalry officer and two of his men set out to make sure that a shipment of guns safely reaches its destination.

673498.title: Daring Danger
673498.description: A wounded cowboy (Tim McCoy) catches rustlers who use a trick branding iron.

673498.title: The Quick Gun
673498.description: A banished gunfighter (Audie Murphy) returns to his sweetheart (Merry Anders) and helps his sheriff friend (James Best) face outlaws.

673498.title: Gunmen From Laredo
673498.description: A framed Texas rancher (Robert Knapp) escapes from prison for a showdown with a saloonkeeper (Walter Coy).

673498.title: Mackenna's Gold
673498.description: Apaches, townsfolk, a Mexican bandit (Omar Sharif) and the cavalry follow a sheriff (Gregory Peck) to a mythical canyon of gold.

673498.title: Blazing Across the Pecos
673498.description: The Durango Kid attempts to thwart an outlaw's plot to turn peaceful Indians against neighboring settlers.

673498.title: Return to Warbow
673498.description: Three escaped convicts return to collect the money that the brother of one of them has already spent.

673498.title: Jubal
673498.description: Searching for work, cowboy Jubal Troop (Glenn Ford) arrives in a small town, where he badly injures his hand. Fortunately, a local rancher, Shep Horgan (Ernest Borgnine), is willing to employ Troop despite the injury. Horgan and Troop work together amicably, but Horgan's two-timing wife (Valerie French) threatens to create discord when she becomes interested in Troop, although he really loves another woman. A jealous cowhand (Rod Steiger) complicates matters by spreading lies.

673498.title: Dirty Little Billy
673498.description: After his family moves to a frontier town in Kansas, city-bred teenager Billy Bonney (Michael J. Pollard) finds he has no appetite for farming. He runs away, taking up with local outlaw Goldie (Richard Evans), who operates a saloon in town with the help of a prostitute named Berle (Lee Purcell). The three form a gang of sorts, menacing the locals until the townsfolk collectively decide to drive the outlaws away. Bonney escapes and begins the life of crime that makes him famous as Billy the Kid.

673498.title: Cripple Creek
673498.description: A federal agent (George Montgomery) and two colleagues infiltrate a gang of gold-rush gold smugglers.

673498.title: The Thrill Hunter
673498.description: After lying about being a stuntman, a blowhard (Buck Jones) gets the chance to prove himself to a movie studio.

673498.title: Ride Lonesome
673498.description: A bounty hunter escorts a killer to prison but allows his outlaw brother to catch up with them to have a showdown over a previous shocking murder.

673498.title: Gunfighters
673498.description: Brazos Kane, a gunslinger who's vowed to kill no more, goes to work for a land baron on a ranch, where he is unjustly accused of murder.

673498.title: Oklahoma Crude
673498.description: In 1913 Oklahoma, a wildcat oil driller reluctantly accepts help from her estranged father and a drifter as she resists pressure to sell her land.

673500.title: Funny Girl
673500.description: In this bittersweet, classic musical drama, the vibrant and beautiful young Fanny Brice (Barbra Streisand) starts out as a bit player on the New York City vaudeville stage, but works her way up to stardom on Broadway. Valued for her vocal and comedic talents by the renowned theater impresario Florenz Ziegfeld (Walter Pidgeon), Fanny thrives, but her relationship with her suave, imprisoned businessman husband, Nick Arnstein (Omar Sharif), is another story.

673500.title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner
673500.description: A daughter visits her family to introduce them to her Black fiancé, whose kindness and loving demeanor changes the hearts of her reluctant parents.

673500.title: Three on a Couch
673500.description: An artist hopes to move to Paris, but his psychiatrist fiancée fears abandoning her patients, so he dons various disguises to cure the lonesome women.

673500.title: The Key
673500.description: In World War II England, a reclusive landlady has a series of relationships with tugboat captains who have each inherited the key to her apartment.

673500.title: The Game That Kills
673500.description: A man infiltrates a hockey team to investigate the death of his brother, the team's star left wing.

673500.title: Jason and the Argonauts
673500.description: A fearless sailor returns to the kingdom of Thessaly after a 20-year voyage to find the Golden Fleece and make his rightful claim to the throne.

673500.title: Theodora Goes Wild
673500.description: Theodora Lynn (Irene Dunne) is secretly the author of a salacious novel written under a pen name. She must hide her identity from the residents of her small, conservative Connecticut town, who disapprove of the book. When Theodora goes to New York to visit her publisher (Thurston Hall), she meets the book's cover artist, Michael Grant (Melvyn Douglas), who tries to convince her to reveal herself as the real author. When Theodora falls for Michael, she soon finds that he has secrets of his own.
