With his radio and navigation equipment disabled, he sails unknowingly into a violent storm and barely escapes with his life. With any luck, the ocean currents may carry him into a shipping lane -- but, with supplies dwindling and the sharks circling, the sailor is forced to face his own mortality. (Adventure, Thriller, Drama) - 2013

starzencorewest.us.title: Win a Date With Tad Hamilton!
starzencorewest.us.description: Pete (Topher Grace), the quirky, self-deprecating manager of a grocery store, is madly in love with his best friend, Rosalee (Kate Bosworth). Unfortunately, she has absolutely no idea. When Rosalee wins a date with her favorite actor, the smarmy Tad Hamilton (Josh Duhamel), Pete delays admitting his feelings to her. And when the scheming Hamilton relocates to their small town to pursue Rosalee in the wake of their initial meeting, a horrified Pete must struggle to win her heart. (Romance, Comedy, Adventure) - 2004

starzencorewest.us.title: The Longest Yard
starzencorewest.us.description: Disgraced pro football quarterback Paul Crewe (Adam Sandler) lands in jail, where manipulative Warden Hazen (James Cromwell) recruits him to advise the institution's team. This turns into a lead role quarterbacking a crew of inmates in a game against a team of prison guards. Aided by incarcerated ex-NFL coach Nate Scarborough (Burt Reynolds), Crewe and his team must overcome not only the bloodthirstiness of the opposition, but also the corrupt officials trying to fix the game against them. (Comedy) - 2005

Earth's billions of inhabitants are unaware that the planet has an expiration date. With the warnings of an American scientist (Chiwetel Ejiofor), world leaders begin secret preparations for the survival of select members of society. When the global cataclysm finally occurs, failed writer Jackson Curtis (John Cusack) tries to lead his family to safety as the world starts falling apart. (Action, Thriller, Drama) - 2009

starzencorewest.us.title: Paranormal Activity
starzencorewest.us.description: Soon after moving into a suburban tract home, Katie (Katie Featherston) and Micah (Micah Sloat) become increasingly disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence. Hoping to capture evidence of it on film, they set up video cameras in the house but are not prepared for the terrifying events that follow. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2007

starzencorewest.us.title: Paranormal Activity 2
starzencorewest.us.description: When the Reys move into their new Southern California home, little do they realize that the house is already occupied. After coming home one day to find the house in disarray -- but with no signs of forced entry or robbery -- they install a video surveillance system to catch the perpetrators. But nothing prepares them for what happens next. (Horror, Thriller) - 2010

starzencorewest.us.title: Last Chance Harvey
starzencorewest.us.description: In London for his daughter's wedding, a struggling jingle-writer, Harvey Shine (Dustin Hoffman), misses his plane to New York, and thus loses his job. While drowning his sorrows in the airport pub, Harvey meets Kate (Emma Thompson), a British government worker stuck in an endless cycle of work, phone calls from her mother, and blind dates. A connection forms between the unhappy pair, who soon find themselves falling in love. (Romance, Drama, Comedy) - 2008

starzencorewest.us.title: Win a Date With Tad Hamilton!
starzencorewest.us.description: Pete (Topher Grace), the quirky, self-deprecating manager of a grocery store, is madly in love with his best friend, Rosalee (Kate Bosworth). Unfortunately, she has absolutely no idea. When Rosalee wins a date with her favorite actor, the smarmy Tad Hamilton (Josh Duhamel), Pete delays admitting his feelings to her. And when the scheming Hamilton relocates to their small town to pursue Rosalee in the wake of their initial meeting, a horrified Pete must struggle to win her heart. (Romance, Comedy, Adventure) - 2004

starzencorewest.us.title: All Is Lost
starzencorewest.us.description: During a solo voyage in the Indian Ocean, a veteran sailor (Robert Redford) must face the possibility of his own death after his vessel, radio and navigation equipment become damaged. - 2013

Earth's billions of inhabitants are unaware that the planet has an expiration date. With the warnings of an American scientist, world leaders begin secret preparations for the survival of select members of society. - 2009

starzencorewest.us.title: Paranormal Activity
starzencorewest.us.description: A young couple (Katie Featherston, Micah Sloat) move into their first new home but are disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence that is most active at night. - 2007

starzencorewest.us.title: Paranormal Activity 2
starzencorewest.us.description: After experiencing what they think are break-ins, a family realizes that the events unfolding before them are more sinister than they seem. - 2010

starzencorewest.us.title: Paranormal Activity 3
starzencorewest.us.description: A videographer becomes obsessed with finding the source of disturbing late-night noises in his home and discovers its terrifying origin. - 2011

starzencorewest.us.title: Paranormal Activity 4
starzencorewest.us.description: A teenager (Kathryn Newton) bears witness to terrifying events that occur when she and her family become the temporary caretakers of a creepy neighbor boy. - 2012

starzencorewest.us.title: Paranormal Activity: The Marked Ones
starzencorewest.us.description: Family and friends try to save a Hispanic teen who appears to be possessed by malevolent supernatural forces. - 2014

starzencorewest.us.title: The Parts You Lose
starzencorewest.us.description: A fugitive forms an unlikely bond with a deaf child when he takes refuge in an abandoned barn on the boy's family's farm. - 2019

starzencorewest.us.title: Hostile Takeover
starzencorewest.us.description: A professional hit man faces a group of assassins after the boss of a crime syndicate suspects disloyalty due to his attendance at Workaholics Anonymous meetings. - 2025

starzencorewest.us.title: Brick Mansions
starzencorewest.us.description: An undercover cop (Paul Walker) joins forces with an ex-con (David Belle) to rescue his kidnapped girlfriend and save Detroit from destruction. - 2014

starzencorewest.us.title: City Island
starzencorewest.us.description: Vince brings home his secret ex-con son to meet the rest of his family, prompting everyone to expose truths. - 2009

starzencorewest.us.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
starzencorewest.us.description: A young man (Matt Damon) travels to 1950s Italy and begins to assume the identity of a playboy (Jude Law) he was hired to bring back to the United States. - 1999

starzencorewest.us.title: Paranormal Activity 3
starzencorewest.us.description: A videographer becomes obsessed with finding the source of disturbing late-night noises in his home and discovers its terrifying origin. (Horror, Thriller) - 2011

starzencorewest.us.title: Paranormal Activity 4
starzencorewest.us.description: It has been five years since Katie (Katie Featherston) murdered her sister and disappeared with her infant nephew, Hunter, in tow. Now, a new family is about to fall prey to nighttime terrors. A mysterious accident next door leads to teenage Alex (Kathryn Newton) and her family becoming the temporary guardians of Robbie (Brady Allen), a very creepy neighbor boy. Cameras installed throughout Alex's home capture the sinister events that unfold after Robbie's arrival. (Horror, Thriller) - 2012

themoviechannel.us.title: The Terminal
themoviechannel.us.description: When Viktor Navorski (Tom Hanks), an Eastern European tourist, arrives at JFK in New York, war breaks out in his country, and he finds himself caught up in international politics. Because of the war, the Department of Homeland Security won't let him enter or exit the United States. He's trapped at JFK -- indefinitely. While living at the airport, Viktor falls for a flight attendant (Catherine Zeta-Jones). She may have feelings for him too. But what good is love if Viktor can't leave the terminal? (Comedy drama) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Up in the Air
themoviechannel.us.description: An idea from a young, new co-worker (Anna Kendrick) would put an end to the constant travel of corporate downsizer Ryan Bingham (George Clooney), so he takes her on a tour to demonstrate the importance of face-to-face meetings with those they must fire. While mentoring his colleague, he arranges hookups with another frequent-flier (Vera Farmiga), and his developing feelings for the woman prompt him to see others in a new light. (Comedy drama, Romance) - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: Blue Valentine
themoviechannel.us.description: Dean (Ryan Gosling) and Cindy (Michelle Williams) live a quiet life in a modest neighborhood. To the casual observer, everything appears normal, if a bit subdued. But a closer examination reveals a couple caught in a downward spiral. They appear to have the world at their feet at the outset of the relationship. However, his lack of ambition and her retreat into self-absorption cause potentially irreversible cracks in their marriage. (Drama, Romance) - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: Sliver
themoviechannel.us.description: Well-to-do book editor Carly Norris (Sharon Stone) moves into a luxury apartment building before learning that a number of female tenants have been dying in grisly ways, allegedly at the hands of a serial killer. Soon, Norris becomes romantically involved with one of the prime suspects, building owner Zeke Hawkins (William Baldwin). The other suspect is her neighbor, writer Jack Landsford (Tom Berenger). Unsure of whom to trust, Norris must uncover the truth before she is the next victim. (Thriller) - 1993

themoviechannel.us.title: Rumpelstiltskin
themoviechannel.us.description: A young widow's wish to see her policeman husband one last time frees a demonic being that wants her infant son's soul. (Horror) - 1995

themoviechannel.us.title: Teaching Mrs. Tingle
themoviechannel.us.description: A hardworking and bright high-school senior, Leigh Ann (Katie Holmes) has her impending status as valedictorian jeopardized when her bitter history teacher, Mrs. Tingle (Helen Mirren), gives her a poor grade on a project. This antagonistic relationship quickly escalates until circumstances lead Leigh Ann and her friends Luke (Barry Watson) and Jo Lynn (Marisa Coughlan) to hold Tingle hostage in her home. As the conflict continues, it looks as if not everyone will make it out alive. (Comedy) - 1999

themoviechannel.us.title: The First Wives Club
themoviechannel.us.description: Despondent over the marriage of her ex-husband to a younger woman, a middle-aged divorcée plunges to her death from her penthouse. At the woman's funeral, her former college friends (Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, Diane Keaton) reunite for the first time in nearly 30 years. When the three discover the reason for their friend's suicide, they realize that all of their ex-husbands have taken them for granted -- and deciding it's time for revenge, they make a pact to get back at their exes. (Comedy) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: He's Just Not That Into You
themoviechannel.us.description: Baltimore-based friends and lovers, all in their 20s and 30s, try to navigate their way through the complexities of modern relationships. Beth (Jennifer Aniston) wants commitment from Neil (Ben Affleck), who sees nothing wrong with the status quo. Gigi (Ginnifer Goodwin) is tired of waiting by the phone, while Mary (Drew Barrymore) has a slew of supportive male friends, none of whom are straight. Meanwhile, Janine has trust issues with her husband, who can't trust himself around Anna. (Romantic comedy) - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: Beavis and Butt-head Do America
themoviechannel.us.description: Two of the biggest animated slackers around, Beavis (Mike Judge) and Butt-head (also Judge) get a kick-start when two crooks steal their TV. On their mission to find a replacement, Beavis and Butt-head wind up in the motel of Muddy Grimes (Bruce Willis), where a case of mistaken identity has them after his wife, Dallas (Demi Moore). Due to misunderstanding Grimes when he says to "do" his wife, the two travel from Las Vegas to Washington, not realizing they've been sent out to kill the woman. (Animated, Comedy) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: Daddy's Home
themoviechannel.us.description: Brad Whitaker (Will Ferrell) is a kindhearted radio executive who wants to be the best possible stepfather to his wife's (Linda Cardellini) two children. When her freewheeling ex-husband, Dusty (Mark Wahlberg), breezes back into town, Brad's feeling of insecurity quickly develops into an inferiority complex. As Dusty demonstrates his flair for athletics, home repair and bad-boy charisma, Whitaker finds himself in a no-holds-barred battle to one-up his rival and win the approval of his family. (Comedy) - 2015

themoviechannel.us.title: Every Breath You Take
themoviechannel.us.description: A psychiatrist's life gets turned upside down when a patient takes her own life, and he introduces her brother to his own family. (Thriller) - 2021

themoviechannel.us.title: We Were Soldiers
themoviechannel.us.description: Based upon the best-selling book "We Were Soldiers Once ... and Young" by Lt. Gen. Harold G. Moore (Ret.) and journalist Joseph L. Galloway, this compelling war drama depicts the true story of the first major battle between the United States and North Vietnamese forces. It is a film about uncommon valor and nobility under fire, loyalty among soldiers, and the heroism and sacrifice of men and women both home and abroad. (War, Historical drama) - 2002

themoviechannel.us.title: Faster
themoviechannel.us.description: Following a 10-year prison stint, Driver (Dwayne Johnson) sprints through the gates to take vengeance on those responsible for his brother's murder. Within hours of dispatching his first one, he has two men on his tail: a veteran police officer (Billy Bob Thornton) and an eager assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen). Driver tries to stay a step ahead of his pursuers, but there are hints that his list is incomplete, and the unknown person may endanger his life. (Action, Thriller) - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: No Country for Old Men
themoviechannel.us.description: While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss. (Crime drama, Thriller, Western) - 2007

themoviechannel.us.title: The Hunted
themoviechannel.us.description: Aided by the FBI, a retired combat-trainer (Tommy Lee Jones) searches for a former student (Benicio del Toro) who is killing civilians in Oregon. - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Organ Trail
themoviechannel.us.description: Abigale and her family fall victim to a gang of ruthless cowboys while making their way across the Oregon Trail. As the only survivor, she does whatever it takes to retrieve her family's horse from the clutches of the bloodthirsty bandits. - 2023

themoviechannel.us.title: The Crow: Wicked Prayer
themoviechannel.us.description: A resurrected ex-convict (Edward Furlong) seeks revenge against Satanists (David Boreanaz, Tara Reid) who murdered both him and his girlfriend. - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Kindred
themoviechannel.us.description: A pair of twisted, young criminals decide to break into a mansion for one big score, but they soon find out that the owners of the house are much more dangerous than they are. - 2025

themoviechannel.us.title: Beavis and Butt-head Do America
themoviechannel.us.description: Beavis and Butt-head travel from Las Vegas to Washington, D.C., not realizing that their landlord has sent them to kill his wife. - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: Seaside
themoviechannel.us.description: A woman decides to run away to the Oregon coast with her boyfriend when he inherits a family beach house. - 2018

themoviechannel.us.title: Escape From Alcatraz
themoviechannel.us.description: A hardened con with a history of prison breaks, is sent to serve the rest of his life sentence at Alcatraz, America's most infamously brutal and inescapable maximum security prison. - 1979

themoviechannel.us.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
themoviechannel.us.description: A beautiful globe-trotter (Angelina Jolie) battles otherworldly creatures for possession of a powerful artifact. - 2001

themoviechannel.us.title: The Running Man
themoviechannel.us.description: A police-state scapegoat (Arnold Schwarzenegger) must play a TV host's (Richard Dawson) deadly game show for the 21st-century masses. - 1987

themoviechannel.us.title: The Untouchables
themoviechannel.us.description: Though Prohibition agent Eliot Ness attempts to take Al Capone down, even his best efforts fail due to widespread corruption within the Windy City's police force. - 1987

themoviechannel.us.title: The Prophecy: Forsaken
themoviechannel.us.description: A lawman (Jason Scott Lee) tries to protect a young woman (Kari Wuhrer) who possesses a book that inhabitants of heaven and hell want. - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Case 39
themoviechannel.us.description: A social worker (Renée Zellweger) saves a girl (Jodelle Ferland) from abusive parents but finds there is more to the child than meets the eye. - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: The Gift
themoviechannel.us.description: Telling fortunes to support herself and her daughter, a psychic widow (Cate Blanchett) assists the police in a missing persons case. - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: Phantoms
themoviechannel.us.description: The resort town of Snowfield, Colo., is under attack by an evil spirit that almost wipes out the entire population, possessing a number of those it kills. As the locals continue to fall victim to the demonic presence, it's up to Sheriff Bryce Hammond (Ben Affleck) to lead the response. He's helped by FBI-employed academic Dr. Timothy Flyte (Peter O'Toole), Deputy Stu Wargle (Liev Schreiber), local doctor Jennifer Pailey (Joanna Going) and her visiting sister, Lisa (Rose McGowan). (Horror) - 1998

wluk.us.title: Best Medicine
wluk.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. wjbk.us.title: Best Medicine
wjbk.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Rear Window
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A newspaper photographer with a broken leg passes time recuperating by observing his neighbors through his window. He sees what he believes to be a murder, and decides to solve the crime himself. With the help of his nurse and wife, he tries to catch the murderer without being killed himself. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 1954

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Paper Moon
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Real-life father and daughter Ryan and Tatum O'Neal team up as slick con-artists Moses Pray and Addie Loggins in the 1930s Kansas. When Moze is unexpectedly saddled with getting the 9-year-old Addie to relatives in Missouri after the death of her mother, his attempt to dupe her out of her money backfires, and he's forced to take her on as a partner. Swindling their way through farm country, the pair is nearly done in by a burlesque dancer and an angry bootlegger. (Comedy) - 1973

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Chicago Syndicate
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An accountant (Dennis O'Keefe) uses microfilm to nail a crime czar (Paul Stewart) for income-tax evasion. (Crime drama) - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Summer of '42
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Teenage Herman Raucher (Gary Grimes), summering on Nantucket Island with his sex-obsessed pals Oscy (Jerry Houser) and Benjie (Oliver Conant) during World War II, meets Dorothy (Jennifer O'Neill), a newlywed in her 20s whose husband is off at war. As his friends awkwardly attempt to woo girls their own age, Herman slowly befriends the older woman and finds himself becoming increasingly in love with her, until a sudden tragedy changes their lives forever. (Romance) - 1971

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Class of '44
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Two friends (Gary Grimes, Jerry Houser) go to college and another (Oliver Conant) joins the Marines in this sequel to "Summer of '42." (Drama) - 1973

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: MGM Parade Show
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films. (Special, Drama) - 2005-12-09

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Night Digger
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Middle-aged Maura Prince (Patricia Neal) lives a lonely life caring for her debilitated mother (Pamela Brown) in a mansion. When mysterious biker Billy Jarvis (Nicholas Clay) arrives at their door looking for work as a handyman, Maura is suspicious of the strange visitor. While Billy proves himself to be kind, he has a dark secret: he's a killer. Despite learning that Billy may be involved in a series of recent murders, Maura cannot help but fall in love with him. (Horror) - 1971

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Night Watch
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Ellen Wheeler (Elizabeth Taylor) is an unhappy housewife who settles her fraying nerves with alcohol while staring out her window. When she witnesses what she thinks is a murder through a neighbor's window, she calls the police, who find nothing when they investigate. With her neglectful husband (Laurence Harvey) skeptical and unsupportive, Ellen turns to her friend Sarah (Billie Whitelaw), who is slightly more receptive as the pair attempt to get to the bottom of the mystery. (Mystery, Horror, Thriller) - 1973

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Chicago Syndicate
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An accountant (Dennis O'Keefe) uses microfilm to nail a crime czar (Paul Stewart) for income-tax evasion. (Crime drama) - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Singin' in the Rain
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A spoof of the turmoil that afflicted the movie industry in the late 1920s when movies went from silent to sound. When two silent movie stars', Don Lockwood and Lina Lamont, latest movie is made into a musical a chorus girl is brought in to dub Lina's speaking and singing. Don is on top of the world until Lina finds out. (Musical comedy) - 1952

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: To Be or Not to Be
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Acting couple Joseph (Jack Benny) and Maria Tura (Carole Lombard) are managing a theatrical troupe when the Nazis invade Poland. Maria is having an affair with Lieutenant Sobinski (Robert Stack), who suspects Professor Siletsky (Stanley Ridges) is a Nazi spy. With Siletsky in possession of a list of members of the Polish resistance, the Turas' company takes action. Using their skill for impersonation, Joseph and company must confuse the Nazis and stop Siletsky from handing over the list. (Comedy) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Night Song
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: At a nightclub, pianist Dan Evans (Dana Andrews) impresses socialite Cathy Mallory (Merle Oberon) with his unique compositions. Learning from Dan's best friend, bandleader Chick Morgan (Hoagy Carmichael), that the proud and embittered Dan is blind, Cathy nevertheless tries to befriend him, only to be rebuffed. The single-minded Cathy then arranges with Chick to meet Dan, pretending to be blind and poor, then secretly arranges a composition contest hoping that Dan will win money for an operation. (Drama) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Picnic at Hanging Rock
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In the early 1900s, Miranda (Anne Lambert) attends a girls boarding school in Australia. One Valentine's Day, the school's typically strict headmistress (Rachel Roberts) treats the girls to a picnic field trip to an unusual but scenic volcanic formation called Hanging Rock. Despite rules against it, Miranda and several other girls venture off. It's not until the end of the day that the faculty realizes the girls and one of the teachers (Vivean Gray) have disappeared mysteriously. (Mystery, Drama) - 1975

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Witness for the Prosecution
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The affable Leonard Vole (Tyrone Power) is being tried for the murder of a wealthy woman, and legendary lawyer Sir Wilfrid Robarts (Charles Laughton) has chosen to represent him. Unfortunately, Leonard's alibi depends on the testimony of his callous wife, Christine (Marlene Dietrich) -- who, after the discovery of a legal loophole, makes the shocking decision to appear in court against him. To Sir Wilfrid's surprise, this is only the first in a series of puzzling revelations and reversals. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1957

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Stage Fright

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Unknown

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Penthouse

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Night Flight

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Prizefighter and the Lady

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Men in White
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A socialite (Myrna Loy) lures a young surgeon (Clark Gable) away from his mentor (Jean Hersholt) and research work. - 1934

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Stamboul Quest
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A U.S. medical student (George Brent) falls for a German spy (Myrna Loy) and follows her to World War I Turkey. - 1934

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Best Years of Our Lives
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Fred, Al and Homer are three World War II veterans facing difficulties as they re-enter civilian life. Fred (Dana Andrews) is a war hero who, unable to compete with more highly skilled workers, has to return to his low-wage soda jerk job. Bank executive Al (Fredric March) gets into trouble for offering favorable loans to veterans. After losing both hands in the war, Homer (Harold Russell) returns to his loving fiancée, but must struggle to adjust. (Drama) - 1946

waga.us.title: Best Medicine
waga.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

wfox.us.title: Best Medicine
wfox.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E1 Spearhead from Space: Episode 1 The TARDIS takes the newly regenerated Doctor to Earth to begin his exile. Brigadier Lethbridge-Stewart leads a UNIT investigation into a mysterious meteorite shower.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E5 Ghost Light: Part 1 The Doctor and Ace explore Victorian house Gabriel Chase and realise it hides just as many dark secrets in its Drawing Room as it does in the dark cellar.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E6 Ghost Light: Part 2 The Doctor and Scotland Yard’s finest, Inspector Mackenzie, attempt to question Josiah Smith while both Light and Control emerge from their respective slumbers.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E7 Ghost Light: Part 3 Only Redvers, still searching for the elusve Saxe-Coburg, seems to be able to withstand Light and communicate with Control and Ace realises her past actions need to be dealt with.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E8 The Curse of Fenric: Part 1 As Russian forces approach the English coastline, an ancient evil stirs beneath the surface of the water. For Ace and the Doctor, a deadly game of revenge has begun.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E9 The Curse of Fenric: Part 2 The Viking runes in the crypt contain a secret to Ace’s past, while Millington and Judson’s Ultima machine offers to break the chains of the Wolves of Fenric.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E10 The Curse of Fenric: Part 3 The Haemovores attack St Jude’s church and the insane Millington willingly sacrifices his men. Doctor Judson dies, only to be reborn as the true evil, Fenric himself.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E11 The Curse of Fenric: Part 4 The Ancient Haemovore stands upon the Earth once again, determined to change the future by erasing the past and Ace finally feels love for her mother.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E12 Survival: Part 1 Trying to work out why people have been disappearing from Perivale, Ace is cornered by a Cheetah-Person on a horse called Kara, who transports her to a far-off planet.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E13 Survival: Part 2 The Doctor and a number of people from Perivale follow Ace to the Cheetah-People’s world, where the Master lies in wait. He cannot leave without the Doctor's assistance.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E14 Survival: Part 3 As the alien world dies around them, the Doctor and the Master fight like animals before escaping to Earth, where their war ends. And somewhere else, the tea is getting cold.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E2 Spearhead from Space: Episode 2 A recovered Doctor escapes the hospital and joins UNIT in their investigation. Meanwhile, Channing directs one of his Auton servants to recover a meteorite.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E3 Spearhead from Space: Episode 3 Sam Seeley has found one of the meteorites but the Autons want it back and are closing in. General Scobie visits Auto Plastics, playing into the hands of Channing.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E4 Spearhead from Space: Episode 4 The invasion begins as Auton shop dummies come to life and attack the public. The Doctor and UNIT infiltrate Auto Plastics where the Doctor faces the Nestene consciousness.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E5 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 1 UNIT are summoned to Wenley Moor research station which is experiencing mysterious power losses. In the nearby caves, one of the staff has been killed and another sent insane.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E6 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 2 Investigating the caves, the Doctor is attacked by a dinosaur-like creature. Dr Quinn is hiding a secret that could endanger the lives of everyone.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E7 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 3 The creature from the caves, wounded and dangerous, is on the loose on Wenley Moor. Dr Quinn attempts to recover it and is unwilling to listen to the Doctor’s warnings.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E8 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 4 Fearful of a war breaking out between the Silurians and mankind, the Doctor attempts to make peace between the races. But there are those on both sides unwilling to listen.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E9 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 5 When the Silurian leader is killed, all hopes of peace are lost. The Silurian’s infect Major Baker with a virus deadly to humans and release him to spread the infection.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E10 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 6 As the Silurian plague quickly spreads, the Doctor desperately searches for a cure. But the Silurians are aware of the Doctor’s efforts and intend to stop him.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E11 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 7 With the antidote to the plague found, the Silurians retaliate and take over the research centre. They now intend to destroy the Van Allen Belt, resulting in death for all mankind.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E12 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 1 Contact has been lost with Mars Probe 7. When contact is also lost with the recovery ship, UNIT is called in and the Doctor learns that someone is sending messages to the vessel.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E13 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 2 Recovery 7 has returned to Earth but the UNIT convoy transporting the capsule is ambushed. The Doctor is able to relocate the capsule, but is he too late?

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E14 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 3 The recovery capsule is empty with the astronauts seemingly kidnapped. But Liz notices that the radiation count is high and the Doctor deduces that the occupants were not human.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E15 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 4 Liz has been captured by Reegan who is holding the three aliens captive. The Doctor suspects Quinlan’s part in the conspiracy, but Quinlan is killed before he can reveal the truth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E16 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 5 The Doctor prepares to pilot the Recovery 7 ship into space, but Reegan sabotages the fuel supply which will send the Doctor into the sun.

BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E20 Inferno: Episode 2 The green slime oozing from the drill head is transforming men into monsters. Stahlman refuses to listen to the warnings and resorts to sabotage so that his project may continue.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E24 Inferno: Episode 6 As the Earth in the parallel world faces destruction, the Doctor is desperate to return to his world to warn them of the danger. But time is running out.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E25 Inferno: Episode 7 The Doctor has escaped the doomed, parallel Earth and has returned to his own world where he attempts to put a halt to the drilling project.

BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E23 Inferno: Episode 5 In the parallel world, Earth’s crust has been penetrated, releasing terrible forces from within the Earth. The Doctor must escape back to his world to prevent the same catastrophe.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E24 Inferno: Episode 6 As the Earth in the parallel world faces destruction, the Doctor is desperate to return to his world to warn them of the danger. But time is running out.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E25 Inferno: Episode 7 The Doctor has escaped the doomed, parallel Earth and has returned to his own world where he attempts to put a halt to the drilling project.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E1 Terror of the Autons: Episode 1 The Master, a renegade Time Lord and a rival of the Doctor’s, arrives on Earth and paves the way for an invasion by the insidious Nestene Consciousness.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E2 Terror of the Autons: Episode 2 The Doctor follows the Master’s trail to the circus. Meanwhile, the Master has used his hypnotic powers to take control of a plastics factory where he creates the deadly Autons.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E3 Terror of the Autons: Episode 3 The Doctor and the Brigadier trace the Master to the plastics factory but they are too late. The only clue to the Master’s plans is a single plastic daffodil.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E4 Terror of the Autons: Episode 4 The Doctor and UNIT race to prevent the Master from broadcasting the deadly activation signal and opening the channel for the Nestene’s arrival on Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E5 The Mind of Evil: Episode 1 At Stangmoor Prison, the Doctor and Jo watch a demonstration of the Keller Machine which can extract evil impulses from criminals. But the experiment goes wrong and a man dies.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E6 The Mind of Evil: Episode 2 A full scale riot takes place at the Prison and Jo is taken hostage. Meanwhile, at the World Peace conference, the Chinese delegate’s aid prepares to kill the American delegate.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Inside Sydney Fish Market
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 End Of An Era With the new $800 million Sydney Fish Market just six days from opening, buyers and merchants are given their first detailed look inside-and not everyone likes what they see.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E2 The Cliffs Of Ireland Bathing sheep and scaling cliffs for crab, Gordon traverses land and sea in search of the culinary wonders of Ireland's stunning Connemara Coast.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour Singapore Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Janice Wong The best bits of Adam Liaw's travels in Singapore, as he explores its vibrant food scene.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E13 Costa Del Sol In The Costa Del Sol, James is shown how paella is made and visits the lost village El Acebuchal. He goes to a citrus farm and learns how muscatel ice cream is made, then cooks Andalusian rice.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour Down Under Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Episode 5 Some of your favourite moments and recipes from Adam Liaw's culinary and cultural journey through Australia and New Zealand.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E14 Cordoba James tours Cordoba on an eco tuk tuk as he visits a food market, eats oxtail at a Michelin-starred restaurant, helps judge a salmorejo competition and sees how pastel Cordobes is made.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour China Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 Lion Head Meatballs The shape of these giant meatballs is meant to resemble a lion’s head, and the green vegetables surrounding them form its mane.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Yes, Chef!
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E10 And The Winner Is.. The chefs are tasked with preparing their very best three-course menu for Jose, Martha, a room full of diners and special guests; to see how much the chefs have grown.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Lemon Chilli Chicken With Turmeric Rice Learn to cook a signature dish at Island Dreams Cafe and an all-round family favourite. Alimah Bilda shares a version with a punchier, thicker sauce that coats the chicken and rice.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Precious Flavours
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Blue Vanilla Bourbon Island is the cradle of vanilla in the Indian Ocean. Now known as Reunion, it produces Bourbon vanilla, the black gold of this volcanic island.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: River Cottage: Veg
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Cost Hugh is well into his summer without meat. Despite this, it's time to take two of the River Cottage sheep to slaughter. However, Hugh now believes vegetables can't be beaten for price and season taste.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Paula McIntyre's Hamely Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E2 Episode 2 Paula demonstrates her fail-safe method for cooking the perfect pork chop with a side of creamy parsnips and smoked potatoes. She pays a visit to Glenarm Castle, where she enlists help.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Frugal Foodie
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Fakeaways Recreate your favourite takeaway meals at home, including Chicken Pad Thai, Lamb Gozleme and a Gluten free Crispy Sweet & Sour Chicken.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Luke Nguyen's Memories Of Food Trail
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Luke's Food Trail, where his busy life was documented, showcasing the life of a restaurateur and businessman balancing many ventures in Australia and abroad while making time for his family.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie Cooks Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Naples This week Jamie heads to fiery Naples, the pizza capital of Italy, to seek out undiscovered family recipes the locals love to eat.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E12 Gemma Collins Prue hosts Mariella Frostrup making smoky, spicy harissa beans. John brings home a new garden sculpture and then joins Prue to cook a classic rhubarb and apple pie.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E15 Granada In Granada, James samples giant tapas, tries pan de alfacar and he goes to an organic caviar farm. He cooks steak, Moroccan chicken, fish with dressed broccoli and carpaccio with caviar.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E4 Furred Game Most people think nothing of eating a chicken but what about a rabbit?

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E11 The Flavors Of Northern Italy After the introduction of the southern Italian classics to American cuisine, the northern flavours began to arrive as well - layered casserole, herbed frittata rollup, and cavatappi with beef guazetto.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Gorgonzola / Taleggio Under the spot light in this episode are gorgonzola and taleggio. Cheese authority Will Studd travels to Northern Italy to see how and where these fascinating cheeses are created.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mark Moriarty: Off Duty Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E3 Menu Three Mark proves that not all sandwiches are created equal! He starts with a Parisian cafe classic, a croque madame and bakes a brown sugar brioche with Chantilly cream.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lorraine's Fast, Fresh And Easy Food
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Comfort Food To start, we cook a breakfast of ginger bread pancakes with parma ham and maple syrup, then a warming prawn linguine with chorizo and cabernet tomato sauce.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Market Day It's the weekly market in Sophie's town, her favourite day of the week. She makes zucchini alla poverella, then learns about stuffed aubergines, and asparagus frittata.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E3 Hasimah Haji Noor: Spicy Chicken, Fried Chilli Eggs & Spicy Malay Noodles All of the dishes like Malaysian Spicy Chicken, Fried Chilli Eggs and Spicy Malay Noodles have come across the ocean from Malaysia and Singapore, to Broome, from Hasimah's father.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 A Summer Lunch Maggie makes grilled cured squid and Simon makes stuffed squid. After Simon takes Iggy for a coffee and gelati, Maggie and Simon both make their version of gelati affogato.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E16 Episode 16 Gerardo Lopez joins Laura in the market to make his Mexican staple, Guacamole,with a brilliant left-of-field twist.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E16 Lamb Chops With Rice And Spinach Rachael prepares a well-rounded meal featuring a French-cut rack of lamb baked with Dijon mustard and seasoned breadcrumbs, accompanied by a side dish of brown and wild rice with porcini mushrooms.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E10 Cudgen It's our season finale this week, and Hayden is back in the NSW Northern Rivers to check out a paddock to plate farm where he stocks up on some super fresh organic produce.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E6 Episode 6 We get a little indulgent with Thomas Schnetzler's decadent chunky, chewy Choc Chip Cookie Tart.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E11 Episode 11 of Season 9 The chefs cook hanger steak with chimichurri sauce, olive salad. prawn risoni and roasted pumpkin with a twist.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E9 Episode 9 Rick pays a memorable visit to the Channel Island of Jersey, where he goes reef fishing for sea bass, which he grills.He also makes a Consomme and enjoys a beach barbecue.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E40 Episode 40 Today's episode is full of incredible recipes including Meatloaf in Smoky Barbecue Sauce, Waffles and a Mint and Coriander Chutney.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E73 Weeknight Gold Ready the dinner podium, because Adam, hatted chef Alejandro Saravia and swimming sensation Ariarne Titmus are on the quest for weeknight gold.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of The Tropics
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: E1 Taste Of The Tropics: Troppo Kitchen Chef Nick Holloway travels across Far North Queensland to source the best ingredients for a tropical feast. Along the way he'll meet and discover the people, places, and beautiful stories there.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Stories
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E14 Midlands Food writer Gurdeep Loyal tours Rick around Leicester's best Indian food, from a hidden gem food truck to Indian high tea. At home Rick cooks our favourite, chicken tikka masala.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks Spain
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Garlic And Grapes Chef Tom Kerridge journeys across the heart of Spain in his bespoke vintage food truck to discover the national obsession with garlic and what it takes to produce grapes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Marion Grasby's Flavours: Heart And Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 Takeaway Favourites Marion shares her homemade takes on favourite takeaway dishes including crispy pork belly banh mi, Thai khao soi noodle soup and sticky Chinese honey chicken.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: The Layover
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E6 Dublin Tony has 36 hours to kill while in Dublin on his layover. From fine dining to excellent pub fare, he does his best to expereience as much Irish hospitality.

Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. kadn.us.title: Best Medicine
kadn.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. khon.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

kljb.us.title: Best Medicine
kljb.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

kmsb.us.title: Best Medicine
kmsb.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. knin.us.title: Best Medicine
knin.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

kptv.us.title: Best Medicine
kptv.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

krxi.us.title: Best Medicine
krxi.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

ktbc.us.title: Best Medicine
ktbc.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

ktvi.us.title: Best Medicine
ktvi.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. kvly.us.title: I Love Lucy
kvly.us.description: Lucy Ricardo is the wacky wife of Cuban bandleader Ricky Ricardo. Living in New York, Ricky tries to succeed in show business while Lucy -- always trying to help -- usually manages to get in some kind of trouble that drives Ricky crazy. Their best friends are Fred and Ethel Mertz, who are also their landlords. Usually, Ethel becomes Lucy's less-than-willing partner in crime. Ricky and Lucy welcomed little Ricky in 1953, whose birth was a national TV event. Later in the show's run, the Ricardos (and the Mertzes) moved to Hollywood, where Ricky tried to become a movie star. (Sitcom) - 1951-10-15

kvly.us.title: Leave It to Beaver
kvly.us.description: This sitcom defines the "golly gee" wholesomeness of 1950s and `60s TV, where dad Ward Cleaver always gets home in time for dinner, mom June cleans the house wearing a dress and pearls, and kids Wally and the Beav always learn a lesson by the end of the episode. kvly.us.title: Gilligan's Island
kvly.us.description: Seven people set sail on what is scheduled to be a three-hour sightseeing tour on the charter boat The Minnow, get caught in a storm and end up stranded on an uncharted tropical island together. The comedy comes from the failed attempts at escaping the island and the interaction of the very diverse group: comprised of a rotund but happy-go-lucky skipper, Jonas Grumby (known as "The Skipper" ); his bumbling but well-meaning first mate, Gilligan; a snobby well-to-do millionaire, Thurston Howell III and his wife, Lovey; a buxom sexy movie star bombshell, Ginger; a high-school science professor, Roy Hinkley (called "The Professor" ); and a nice country girl, Mary Ann. Viewers of the venerable series would be correct to ponder the impossible number of guests who visited the islands, the incredible versatility of the common coconut and the fact that the castaways somehow managed to win the Palme d'Or at the Cannes Film Festival. (Sitcom, Comedy) - 1964-09-26

kvly.us.title: Mama's Family
kvly.us.description: Thelma "Mama" Harper is the quick-tempered, blue-haired matriarch of the Harper family who lives with son Vint and his wife, Naomi, who were forced to move into Mama's basement after losing money in a business deal gone awry. After Vint's kids from a previous marriage leave the house, Mama's delinquent grandson Bubba is ordered to live with his grandmother after being released from juvenile hall and placed on probation. Iola Boylen, Thelma's friend and neighbor, is a frequent visitor to the Harper household, which is often the site of bickering between abrasive Mama and her loved ones. Vicki Lawrence stars as Mama, a character she originated in sketches on "The Carol Burnett Show." (Sitcom) - 1983-01-22

kvrr.us.title: Best Medicine
kvrr.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

nbcuniverso.us.title: Escape perfecto - Estudios pagados
nbcuniverso.us.description: Ericka y Mónica buscan salir llenas de regalos y aunque la tía parece que va viento en popa, un fonógrafo se interpone entre sus metas. Los primos Kevin y Jocelyn quieren dinero para sus estudios. (Game Shows, Performing Arts)

nbcuniverso.us.title: El final del paraíso - La negación
nbcuniverso.us.description: Valeria gana más popularidad en el país y Albeiro no quiere creer lo que dicen de ella, solo recuerda los bellos momentos que pasaron juntos en cautiverio y la busca desesperadamente. (Soaps, Drama)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Copa Mundial Femenina Sub-17 de la FIFA 2026 - España Sub-17 vs. México Sub-17
nbcuniverso.us.description: Cobertura de la décima edición del torneo femenino en la categoría Sub-17, con sede en Marruecos. (Sports, Soccer)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Historias de la Virgen morena - Día de las Madres
nbcuniverso.us.description: Álvaro abandona su casa, le dice a Soledad que ya no la ama. Los hijos le reclaman a la madre lo sucedido y deciden irse también. Después de maltratarla, se ven obligados a pedir perdón. (Religious, Drama)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Copa Mundial Femenina Sub-17 de la FIFA 2026 - Estados Unidos Sub-17 vs. Samoa Sub-17
nbcuniverso.us.description: Acción de la jornada 1 del Grupo E del Mundial Femenino Sub-17. Estados Unidos inicia su camino ante Samoa que hace su primera aparición. (Sports, Soccer)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Fútbol Premier League - Tottenham Hotspur vs. Coventry City
nbcuniverso.us.description: Jornada 7 de la temporada 2026-27 de la Premier League. Tottenham Hotspur se enfrenta a Coventry City. Desde el estadio Tottenham Hotspur. (Sports, Soccer)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Un día para vivir - Querida mamá
nbcuniverso.us.description: Florencia debe resolver un asunto antes de partir. De lo contrario, su hermanito estará en grave peligro y ella es la única que puede salvarlo, aunque eso signifique arriesgar su vida. (Soaps, Drama)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Acércate a Rocío - Mi mamá se enredó con el amigo de mi papá
nbcuniverso.us.description: La familia está enfrentada por la decisión de Carolina que, ante los maltratos y abusos de su esposo, comenzó una nueva vida. Blanca, su hija, se opone a esa relación por las consecuencias. (Talk Shows, Lifestyle)

nbcuniverso.us.title: Top Chef VIP
nbcuniverso.us.description: La presión lleva al límite a veinte celebridades que enfrentan los más exigentes desafíos ante un equipo de expertos. Solo uno recibirá el título de Top Chef VIP y el premio de 200 mil dólares. (Game Shows, Food)

waladt.us.title: Best Medicine

Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. witi.us.title: Best Medicine
witi.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. wfxgdt.us.title: Best Medicine
wfxgdt.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

wgbc.us.title: Best Medicine
wgbc.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

wghp.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. wghpdt.us.title: Best Medicine
wghpdt.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. wsvn.us.title: Best Medicine
wsvn.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. wtvt.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. Best Medicine
wtxf.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. wztv.us.title: Best Medicine
wztv.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04
