kfxk.us.title: Best Medicine
kfxk.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. kfxv.us.title: Best Medicine
kfxv.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

kmph.us.title: Best Medicine
kmph.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

kscc.us.title: Best Medicine
kscc.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

ksccdt.us.title: Best Medicine
ksccdt.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. fxm.us.title: Ghostbusters II
fxm.us.description: After saving New York City from a ghost attack, the Ghostbusters -- a team of spirit exterminators -- is disbanded for demolishing parts of the city during the battle. But when Ghostbuster Peter Venkman learns that spirits have taken an interest in his son, the men launch a rogue ghost-chasing mission. The quest quickly goes awry, landing them in court. But when the ghosts turn on the judge, he issues an order allowing the Ghostbusters to get back to work. (Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure) - 1989

fxm.us.title: Ghostbusters

When strange apparitions appear in Manhattan, Gilbert and Yates turn to engineer Jillian Holtzmann for help. Also joining the team is Patty Tolan, a lifelong New Yorker who knows the city inside and out. Armed with proton packs and plenty of attitude, the four women prepare for an epic battle as more than 1,000 mischievous ghouls descend on Times Square. (Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure, Action) - 2016

Returning after 15 years and calling himself Sweeney Todd, the now-mad man vows revenge, applying his razor to unlucky customers and shuttling the bodies down to Mrs. Lovett (Helena Bonham Carter), who uses them in her meat-pie shop. Though many fall to his blade, he will not be satisfied until he slits Turpin's throat. (Musical, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2007

After he creates his own monster (Peter Boyle), new complications ensue with the arrival of the doctor's fiancée, Elizabeth (Madeline Kahn). (Comedy) - 1974

Now, in 1964, Charlotte is an old recluse and must fight to keep her home. She enlists the help of her cousin Velma (Olivia de Havilland), who was there at the time of the murder. However, soon after Velma's arrival, Charlotte's mind becomes unstable, and she starts seeing her dead lover's head. (Horror) - 1965

Ellen quickly becomes obsessed with Richard and abandons her fiancé, Russell Quinton (Vincent Price), to be with him. The couple rushes into marriage, with both of them caught up in romance and Richard intrigued by Ellen's intensity. Only after settling into marriage, however, does Richard realize that she is psychotically jealous and highly unstable. (Crime drama) - 1945

fxm.us.title: Laura
fxm.us.description: In one of the most celebrated 1940s film noirs, Manhattan detective Mark McPherson (Dana Andrews) investigates the murder of Madison Avenue executive Laura Hunt (Gene Tierney) in her fashionable apartment. On the trail of her murderer, McPherson quizzes Laura's arrogant best friend, gossip columnist Waldo Lydecker (Clifton Webb) and her comparatively mild fiancé, Shelby Carpenter (Vincent Price). As the detective grows obsessed with the case, he finds himself falling in love with the dead woman. (Mystery) - 1944

fxm.us.title: The Lodger
fxm.us.description: In London in 1889, retiree Robert Burton (Cedric Hardwicke) and his wife, Ellen (Sara Allgood), rent a spare room to the mysterious Slade (Laird Cregar) as Jack the Ripper continues to terrorize the city. The Burtons' niece, Kitty (Merle Oberon), is a music hall singer who initially grows fond of the eccentric lodger, but, when the Ripper's body count rises, she and a Scotland Yard inspector (George Sanders) gradually begin to suspect that Slade could be the notorious Whitechapel killer. (Thriller) - 1944

bbcamerica.us.title: Poltergeist
bbcamerica.us.description: Strange and creepy happenings beset an average California family, the Freelings -- Steve (Craig T. Nelson), Diane (JoBeth Williams), teenaged Dana (Dominique Dunne), eight-year-old Robbie (Oliver Robins), and five-year-old Carol Ann (Heather O'Rourke) -- when ghosts commune with them through the television set. Initially friendly and playful, the spirits turn unexpectedly menacing, and, when Carol Ann goes missing, Steve and Diane turn to a parapsychologist and eventually an exorcist for help. (Horror, Thriller) - 1982

bbcamerica.us.title: The Exorcist
bbcamerica.us.description: One of the most profitable horror movies ever made, this tale of an exorcism is based loosely on actual events. When young Regan (Linda Blair) starts acting odd -- levitating, speaking in tongues -- her worried mother (Ellen Burstyn) seeks medical help, only to hit a dead end. A local priest (Jason Miller), however, thinks the girl may be seized by the devil. The priest makes a request to perform an exorcism, and the church sends in an expert (Max von Sydow) to help with the difficult job. (Horror) - 1973

bbcamerica.us.title: The Omen
bbcamerica.us.description: American diplomat Robert (Gregory Peck) adopts Damien (Harvey Stephens) when his wife, Katherine (Lee Remick), delivers a stillborn child. After Damien's first nanny hangs herself, Father Brennan (Patrick Troughton) warns Robert that Damien will kill Katherine's unborn child. Shortly thereafter, Brennan dies and Katherine miscarries when Damien pushes her off a balcony. As more people around Damien die, Robert investigates Damien's background and realizes his adopted son may be the Antichrist. (Horror, Thriller) - 1976

bbcamerica.us.title: Cujo
bbcamerica.us.description: In this tale of a killer canine, man's best friend turns into his worst enemy. When sweet St. Bernard Cujo is bitten by a bat, he starts behaving oddly and becomes very aggressive. As Cujo morphs into a dangerous beast, he goes on a rampage in a small town. Stay-at-home mom Donna (Dee Wallace) gets caught in Cujo's crosshairs on a fateful errand with her son, Tad (Danny Pintauro). Stuck in their tiny car, Donna and Tad have a frightening showdown with the crazed animal. (Horror, Thriller) - 1983

bbcamerica.us.title: Pet Sematary
bbcamerica.us.description: Doctor Louis Creed (Dale Midkiff) moves his family to Maine, where he meets a friendly local named Jud Crandall (Fred Gwynne). After the Creeds' cat is accidentally killed, Crandall advises Louis to bury it in the ground near the old pet cemetery. The cat returns to life, its personality changed for the worse. When Louis' son, Gage (Miko Hughes), dies tragically, Louis decides to bury the boy's body in the same ground despite the warnings of Crandall and Louis' visions of a deceased patient. (Horror, Thriller) - 1989

5starmax.us.title: Space Jam
5starmax.us.description: Swackhammer (Danny DeVito), an evil alien theme park owner, needs a new attraction at Moron Mountain. When his gang, the Nerdlucks, heads to Earth to kidnap Bugs Bunny (Billy West) and the Looney Tunes, Bugs challenges them to a basketball game to determine their fate. The aliens agree, but they steal the powers of NBA basketball players, including Larry Bird (Larry Bird) and Charles Barkley (Charles Barkley) -- so Bugs gets some help from superstar Michael Jordan (Michael Jordan). (Family, Comedy, Adventure, Animated) - 1996

5starmax.us.title: Due Date
5starmax.us.description: Peter Highman will be a dad for the first time when his wife gives birth in five days. He intends to catch a flight home from Atlanta so he can be there for the delivery, but a chance encounter with aspiring actor Ethan Tremblay throws a monkey wrench into his plans. Desperate to reach his wife before their baby is born, Peter's sanity is tested when he must take a road trip cross-country with dog-toting Ethan. (Dark comedy, Comedy drama) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
5starmax.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

5starmax.us.title: They All Laughed
5starmax.us.description: The employees of New York City's Odyssey Detective Agency can't seem to prevent themselves from getting over-involved in their clients' lives. When aging gumshoe John Russo (Ben Gazzara) is assigned to trail an Italian millionaire's wife, Angela (Audrey Hepburn), he inevitably falls for her continental charm. His partner, Charles (John Ritter), is similarly unable to keep his hands off the woman he's trailing -- a winsome cheating spouse named Dolores (Dorothy Stratten). (Romantic comedy) - 1981

5starmax.us.title: Son of Godzilla
5starmax.us.description: In this Japanese monster movie, the massive Godzilla comes to the aid of his newborn son, who hatches from an egg on a remote island where scientists are conducting experiments with radioactivity. Revealing a surprising paternal streak, Godzilla tries to teach his much smaller progeny how to use his powers. The father/son team must then battle giant insects, including praying mantises and a formidable spider. Can Godzilla protect his curious tyke from the gargantuan bugs? (Science fiction) - 1967

5starmax.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
5starmax.us.description: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims. (Dark comedy) - 1971

5starmax.us.title: The Art of Getting By
5starmax.us.description: George (Freddie Highmore) is a senior at a posh Manhattan prep school, but his disaffected attitude leaves little room for toeing the line. He'd rather doodle and read philosophy, and he strenuously avoids his parents (Rita Wilson, Sam Robards) whenever possible. Unfortunately, George's attitude is endangering his chances of graduating. Then he meets Sally (Emma Roberts). George finds himself falling in love with her, but an older artist (Michael Angarano) adds a complication to the mix. (Comedy drama) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: The Switch
5starmax.us.description: Neurotic Wally Mars has one bright spot in his life: his friendship with Kassie. When Kassie announces her intention to become pregnant using a sperm donor, Wally thinks he will be the lucky guy, but Kassie has someone else in mind. While drunk at Kassie's insemination party, Wally substitutes his sperm for the donor's, then passes out, remembering nothing. Seven years later, Wally meets Kassie's son, who seems oddly familiar to him. (Romantic comedy) - 2010

hdnetmovies.us.title: Chato's Land
hdnetmovies.us.description: Half-Apache Pardon Chato (Charles Bronson) finds himself in a bar fight with a bigoted sheriff and kills the man to save his own life. The locals won't accept this defense, though, and angry Civil War veteran Quincey Whitmore (Jack Palance) rounds up a gang of toughs to track down Chato, who is forced to flee the scene. But when the posse finds Chato's family and brutalizes them, the escapee decides it's time to stop running and start taking revenge on the lynch mob. (Western) - 1972

hdnetmovies.us.title: Young Billy Young
hdnetmovies.us.description: Fleeing the scene of a gruesome gunfight in Mexico, Billy Young (Robert Walker) arrives in the small town of Lordsburg, where he is promptly deputized by local sheriff Ben Kane (Robert Mitchum). Kane takes the troubled young man under his wing, hoping to reform his lawless ways. As the bond between the two men grows stronger, Kane recruits Young for a particularly personal assignment: to help bring to justice Frank Boone (John Anderson), a vicious outlaw responsible for the death of his son. (Western) - 1969

The groups of brothers go their separate ways, with Cole Younger (David Carradine) considering settling down with his feisty girlfriend, Belle Starr (Pamela Reed). hdnetmovies.us.title: Angel and the Badman
hdnetmovies.us.description: Quirt Evans (John Wayne), a cowboy on the run, is injured when his horse stumbles near a Quaker family's land. The family takes him in as he regains his health, and he falls for their young daughter, Penelope (Gail Russell). As Quirt falls deeper in love and becomes accustomed to the family's peaceful ways, his violent past starts to catch up to him. Eventually he is forced to decide whether it is worth letting go of his turbulent former life for his future with Penelope. (Western) - 1947

indieplex.us.title: Closing the Ring
indieplex.us.description: During the 1940s, a group of young men go off to war, leaving behind Ethel Ann (Mischa Barton), who is in love with one of them, Teddy. In modern-day Belfast, a man named Jimmy (Martin McCann) endeavors to return a ring found in the wreckage of a crashed plane. He travels to Michigan, where the grown Ethel Ann (Shirley MacLaine), who married another man after Teddy was killed in battle, now lives. Ethel Ann must decide whether to go with Jimmy to meet the soldier who last saw Teddy alive. (Drama, Romance) - 2007

indieplex.us.title: Black Sheep
indieplex.us.description: Sheep-fearing Henry (Nathan Meister) returns to his brother's (Peter Feeney) New Zealand farm, hoping his sibling will buy out his share of the property. However, what he finds are genetically altered sheep that prey on humans and turn their victims into undead, woolly killers. Shear madness ensues as Henry, an animal-rights activist (Danielle Mason) and a farmhand (Tammy Davis) set out to stop the rampaging animals. (Horror, Comedy) - 2006

Most of the other Beecham residents are delighted, and try to convince Jean to join them in a performance of "Rigoletto." Jean, however, knows that she is long past her prime and is reluctant to sully the memory of her once-lovely voice. (Comedy drama) - 2012

indieplex.us.title: Closing the Ring

He travels to Michigan, where the grown Ethel Ann (Shirley MacLaine), who married another man after Teddy was killed in battle, now lives. Ethel Ann must decide whether to go with Jimmy to meet the soldier who last saw Teddy alive. (Drama, Romance) - 2007

indieplex.us.title: Youth in Oregon
indieplex.us.description: When 79-year-old curmudgeon Raymond (Frank Langella) makes arrangements to be euthanized in Oregon, his family refuses to accept his decision. But when another family emergency arises, Raymond's daughter Kate (Christina Applegate) turns to her husband, Brian (Billy Crudup), for a little help. So Brian reluctantly volunteers to drive the cantankerous Raymond and his wine-loving wife, Estelle (Mary Kay Place), to Oregon. (Comedy drama) - 2016

indieplex.us.title: Dope

A chance encounter with a drug dealer named Dom lands Malcolm and company at the dealer's nightclub birthday party; when the scene turns violent, they flee -- with the Ecstasy that Dom secretly hid in Malcolm's backpack. A wild adventure ensues as the youths try to evade armed thugs who want the stash. (Comedy) - 2015

retroplex.us.title: McLintock!
retroplex.us.description: Aging rancher George Washington McLintock, a wealthy self-made man, is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men, McLintock's own sons and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife, who left him two years previously, suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in her husband -- she wants custody of their daughter. (Western, Comedy) - 1963

retroplex.us.title: The Proud Rebel
retroplex.us.description: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. Desperate to cure the boy, Chandler takes David to a small town in Illinois where he hopes to find a doctor. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault — and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland). (Western) - 1958

retroplex.us.title: Outlaws of the Plains
retroplex.us.description: An impressionable cowpoke, Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), hears a voice claiming to be that of an old Native American, telling him the location of some hidden gold. Fuzzy does find gold, but the land has already been claimed by Nord Finner (Charles King Jr.). Finner offers to sell his claim, and Fuzzy is eager to buy. Then Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe), a friend of Fuzzy's, shows up and discovers that a gang of outlaws is behind a scheme to rob everyone in the area. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Pioneer Justice
retroplex.us.description: Something strange is going on in the frontier town of Buffalo Gap. After two men turn up dead, a marshal named Cheyenne (Al "Lash" La Rue) arrives, along with his partner, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), to investigate. Although the outlaw Bill Judd (Jack Ingram) seems to be behind the deaths, the sheriff is not taking any action. When Cheyenne learns the sheriff may be taking orders from another party, he and Fuzzy try to find out who is controlling the criminal element. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Romance of the West
retroplex.us.description: Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), along with his sidekick, Ezra (Emmett Lynn), oversees the peaceful coexistence of the Native American tribes with the white settlers of Antelope Valley. The treaty that binds the two groups is threatened when some of the town leaders learn that the Native American land contains rich deposits of silver. Eager to oust the tribes and claim the silver, the town leaders try to provoke an attack that would break the treaty. It's up to Eddie to stop them in time. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: The Tioga Kid
retroplex.us.description: With assistance from partner Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), Texas Ranger Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) helps rancher Jenny Morgan (Jennifer Holt) recover her stolen herd. For Eddie, the theft comes as a shock, as it may have been perpetrated by his twin, who is known as "the Tioga Kid" (also Dean). Suddenly, the brothers are at odds as never before. Things get even dicier when wanted posters depict a man who looks exactly like Eddie, causing some to believe that he's actually the bad guy. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: The Dawn Rider
retroplex.us.description: John Mason (John Wayne) suffers a cruel homecoming when he witnesses his father's murder as he rides into town. Incensed, he chases after the killers, but he suffers a gunshot wound that cuts his pursuit short. Alice Gordon (Marion Burns) sees to his injury, and Mason is taken by her kindness and beauty. But things turn sour when her beau, Ben (Reed Howes), becomes jealous. After Mason discovers the men who killed his father, his plan for a duel is sabotaged by Ben, who has been manipulated. (Western) - 1935

retroplex.us.title: Check Your Guns
retroplex.us.description: Gunslinger Eddie (Eddie Dean) rides into the Wild West town of Red Gap, Colo., which is run by land-hungry saloon owner Brad Taggert (Stan Jolley) and corrupt circuit judge Hammond (Bill Fawcett). When the sheriff is killed by members of Taggert's gang, Eddie is appointed to take his place. Along with his deputy, barbershop owner Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), and ranch owner Cathy Jordan (Nancy Gates), Eddie takes aim at Taggert and his gang, led by sharpshooter Ace Bannion (Mikel Conrad). (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: The Desert Trail
retroplex.us.description: John Scott (John Wayne) is a rodeo rider, assisted by his buddy Kansas Charlie (Eddy Chandler). But while the duo is settling a debt with their promoter, Farnsworth (Henry Hall), thieves Pete (Al Ferguson) and Jim (Paul Fix) murder and rob Farnsworth and manage to pin the crimes on John and Charlie. The accused then flee, assume two new identities, take up with a shopkeeper named Anne (Mary Kornman) and set out to clear their names and bring the real killers to justice. (Western) - 1935

retroplex.us.title: Cheyenne Takes Over
retroplex.us.description: U.S. Marshal Cheyenne (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his sidekick, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are en route to a much-needed vacation at Fuzzy's friend's ranch. But, upon arriving, the partners find that Fuzzy's pal has been killed, and a fishy group of characters has taken over the ranch, claiming to have inherited it from the dead man. Immediately suspicious, the lawmen team up with local saloon owner Fay Wilkins (Nancy Gates), and forgo their vacation in favor of a murder investigation. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: The Man From Utah
retroplex.us.description: One day, John Weston (John Wayne) helps stop a bank robbery. George Higgins (George Hayes), the town's grateful marshal, asks Weston for his help in solving another crime. It seems someone at a touring rodeo show is killing the top riders before they can take home the trophy -- and the prize money. Weston agrees to investigate and works his way into the show, which is run by the shady Spike Barton (Edward Peil). As Weston gets closer to the truth, he finds himself in even greater danger. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: Rimfire
retroplex.us.description: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Under California Stars
retroplex.us.description: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom. (Western) - 1948

365blk.us.title: Kickboxer
365blk.us.description: Eric Sloane (Dennis Alexio) is an American kickboxing pro, helped by his brother, Kurt (Jean-Claude Van Damme), in his quest for glory. But when the two go to Thailand to take on legendary Tong Po (Michel Qissi), the opponent viciously beats Eric and leaves him paralyzed. Swearing vengeance, Kurt tracks down master Xian Chow (Dennis Chan) and begins learning the sport himself while also getting caught up in criminal intrigue involving thuggish crime boss Freddy Li (Ka Ting Lee). (Action, Martial arts) - 1989

When she's murdered, he grudgingly teams up with her boyfriend, Jimmy Dix (Damon Wayans), an ex-quarterback with a gambling problem, and the two go after her killers. Before long, they stumble onto a plot by a well-known football magnate (Noble Willingham) to bribe federal legislators into legalizing sports gambling. (Action) - 1991

365blk.us.description: Winslow Lowry (Anthony Geary) is a greedy man determined to get his hands on the fortune of his ailing and very wealthy uncle, Albert Dennison (Ralph Bellamy). As a way to hasten Uncle Albert's death, Winslow puts him in the care of three hapless orderlies -- Buffy, Markie and Kool, also known as the Fat Boys (The Fat Boys) -- but their jolly dispositions actually make the elderly man feel better. When Winslow steps up his devious efforts, can the trio stop him? (Comedy) - 1987

Intent on driving back to Chicago to win Rae back, Michael instead finds himself stuck in a hillbilly town. (Comedy) - 2000

Ray is at first reluctant to get involved, but he soon finds he must rally his team and take matters into his own hands. (Action) - 2013

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E10 Big Picture: The United Nations Offensive A look at the 1950 attacks against the Communist army in Korea by United Nations' forces.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Architects of Darkness
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E06 Adolf Hitler Explores the roots of Adolf Hitler and traces the story of his life from the town of his birth to his final days in a Berlin bunker.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E13 Progress to Peace The pacification and Vietnamization efforts of the U.S. Army in Vietnam.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War 2 - The Call of Duty: A Complete Timeline
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E05 Fighting Further Afield (October - December 1940) Tracking the main events of WWII with the help of archive footage; learning about Pearl Harbor, The Battle of Britain, D-Day, the dropping of the atomic bomb, and more; from the early battles right through to the complexities of the endgame.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War 2 - The Call of Duty: A Complete Timeline
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E06 On Land, In the Air and All at Sea (January - March 1941) The Luftwaffe continues its attempts to bomb Britain into submission; the German Afrika Korps strengthens its position as Rommel, Hitler's "Desert Fox", takes charge; at sea, naval forces battle each other and the elements.

combatwarchannel.us.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E03 Newsreel Reports on Preparation for D-Day Prefabricated concrete barges are manufactured in preparation for D-Day, and U.S. troops storm a beach in a practice landing assault; a look at how harbor facilities, which were made in England, were used in the Normandy invasion.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Visions of War: D-Day: The Longest of Days
combatwarchannel.us.description: Invasion of Southern France The invasion of Southern France and the subsequent junction with the American army in northwest France.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E04 Big Picture: A Nation Builds Under Fire How the people of the Republic of Vietnam attempted to build a nation amidst the holocaust of war.

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWI the War to End All Wars, Part 1: The Valley of Death
combatwarchannel.us.description: During a time of apparent tranquility and peace, the buildup to World War I was deceptively quiet, but chaos and carnage arrived swiftly.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Secrets of the Nazis
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E06 Ambassadors in Berlin: The Whistleblowers of WWII In 1933, Hitler rose to power and the Nazis seized control; foreign diplomats in Berlin witnessed the regime's rise and Jewish persecution-but their warnings went unheeded.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Secrets of the Nazis
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E05 Nazi Creatures Hitler, Göring and Himmler shared a strange obsession with animals, using them as propaganda tools, symbols of ideology and even weapons of war; far beyond affection, their fascination fueled pseudo-scientific projects and genetic manipulation.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Night Swallows
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E01 Episode 1 Zhenya faces an extremely dangerous task: to destroy the enemy ammunition and fuel station; her best friend is demoted and faces a tribunal.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
combatwarchannel.us.description: S02 E15 Big Picture: Third Korean Winter Depicting soldiers' daily living in the Korean War during the winter period 1952-53.

combatwarchannel.us.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E15 Good Bye Vietnam The story of the last hours of the Fall of Saigon.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
combatwarchannel.us.description: True, untold combat stories of everyday citizen soldiers fighting on the front lines of Europe during WWII.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Death Train
combatwarchannel.us.description: Revisiting the first massive crime of WWII killing 13,000 people in the city of Iasi, Romania that lays out the early stages of the Shoah.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Visions of War: U.S. Marines
combatwarchannel.us.description: Land the Landing Force Visions of War: U.S. Marines

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War II: The Price of Empire
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E11 Unconditional Surrender Carpet bombing destroys Dresden, the capital of Saxony, Germany; Russian troops enter Berlin; Hitler commits suicide and the Third Reich accepts unconditional surrender; VE Day.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Soviet Storm
combatwarchannel.us.description: S02 E04 The Battle of the Caucasus An attack on Soviet oil fields could have led to a victory, but resistance thwarted Hitler's dream.

combatwarchannel.us.description: The concentration camp deportees became the rare witnesses to mass extermination.

bbcearth.us.title: Snow Wolf Family and Me
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Survival of the Pups Gordon Buchanan uses his skills as a wildlife cameraman to gain the trust of a white wolf family; as spring turns to summer, he becomes accepted by the pack, including mother Luna and her three newborn pups.

bbcearth.us.title: Snow Wolf Family and Me
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Big Bad Wolves Gordon Buchanan reunites with his white wolf family as they try to raise their pups and prepare for winter; he walks with wolves as they hunt lemmings, muskox and hares and encounter a rival pack.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Battle to Save the Tiger Investigating India's growing problem with tiger poaching; tiger scientist turned whistleblower, Raghu uncovers the scale of the problem.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Nature's Biggest Beasts How the world's biggest beasts overcome the challenges of their size.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: The Dragon's Bite Dr. Bryan Fry discovers there's a lot more to the Komodo dragon than meets the eye - from hidden venom glands to its secret origins.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Highgrove: A Prince's Legacy Charting a year in the running of Highgrove, home to the Prince of Wales, who takes an active part in the management of the organic garden and estate.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Five Big Cats and a Camera The lives of cheetahs, leopards, servals, caracals and lions.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Echo of the Elephants: The Next Generation The elephant calf Ely is followed for four years through Kenya's Amboseli National Park.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: The Bat Man of Mexico Featuring the story of Rodrigo Medellin, who has dedicated his life to saving bats.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Lions: Pride in Peril A film following the Tokitok pride of lions in Tanzania's breathtaking Ngorongoro Crater.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Rachel shines a spotlight on Melbourne's sport fanatics' favorite gourmet fast food and cooks up a storm with the city's original food truck proprietor.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Keen to explore this melting pot of cuisines, Rachel explores a Vietnamese food market, tracks down a suburban hot bed of Greek eats, and learns how to make passata from an Italian-Australian nonna.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Rachel explores one of the lesser-known regions on Melbourne's doorstep, the Dandenongs, where she meets up with Argentinian chef Mauro Callegari.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 On her last few days in Melbourne, Rachel takes a look at the city's current and future food trends and throws a barbecue party for the foodies she has met during her time in Australia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Dieppe Rick Stein embarks on a new journey through the byways of France, from the Channel to the Mediterranean, always on the lookout for things where the British could learn from the French to enhance lives.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Alsace and Jura Rick Stein goes through France's eastern border regions of Alsace and Jura home to his favorite French dish, choucroute garni and favorite French cheese, comté.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Burgundy Rick Stein continues exploring Burgundy and practices a little entente cordiale with a château owner who cooks him sorrel soup straight out of the garden.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Perigord Rick Stein arrives in the region of Perigord, famous for decadent dishes; he discovers his favorite market in the city of Perigueux and learns about the region's historical relationship with England as the former kingdom of Aquitaine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Roussillon Rick Stein's journey of discovery brings him to the sunnier climes of the Mediterranean, where he explores the French-Catalan legacy of Roussillon on the foothills of the Pyrenees next to the Spanish border.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Languedoc Rick Stein approaches the end of his meander through France with a final glance at the culinary delights of the Languedoc before crossing over to Provence and the Mediterranean coastline that reveals new insights into southern French cuisine.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E01 Shellfish Chef Blanc celebrates the best of British shellfish as he cooks dishes including Moules Marinière, seared squid salad and Scottish lobster.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E02 Cakes and Pastries Chef Raymond begins with a feather-light lemon tea cake, coated in an apricot jam and tangy lemon glaze; he also makes a choux pastry filled with chocolate cream and covered with a chocolate icing; lastly, the secrets to the perfect macarons.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E03 Lamb Chef Blanc shares his favorite lamb dishes: lamb liver with caramelized potatoes and French seasoning, a slow-roasted garlic and herb lamb shoulder with potato and turnip gratin and lamb Provencal with ratatouille.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E04 Pudding Raymond celebrates his passion for puddings, cooking dishes including riz au lait, tarte tatin and fruit crumble.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E05 Charcuterie Chef Raymond shares his love of charcuterie, beginning with thin slices of duck cured in herbs and juniper berries; also, he makes a chicken liver parfait and a meaty pot-au-feu medley; lastly, a ham hock terrine served with home-made pickles.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E06 Spices and Chillies Drawing upon his travels through Asia, Raymond creates dishes full of fragrant spice and fiery heat.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E07 Summer Fruits Raymond demonstrates the versatility of the summer's juiciest fruits with a simple but impressive berry-strewn pavlova and a spicy cherry clafoutis where the vibrant fruit is cushioned in a bed of soft, sumptuous pastry.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E08 Summer Greens Raymond celebrates the freshest summer greens, beginning with a simple yet vibrant pistou soup, laden with summer vegetables and bursting with basil, topped with crispy croutons and meltingly rich Parmesan.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 San Francisco to Monterey Rick enjoys sitting on the dock of the bay in San Francisco, tasting legendary dishes like the hangtown fry; San Francisco is also the home of sourdough and where America's love affair with seasonal cooking took hold.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Monterey to San Diego Rick Stein continues traveling down the Californian coastline immortalized by Steinbeck.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 San Diego to Baja California Rick enjoys a hearty steak and eggs American diner special and bids a fond farewell to his trusty Ford Mustang as he heads across what is reputed to be the busiest border crossing in the world.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Guadalajara to Puerto Vallarta Rick lands in the town that gave the world tequila and the metropolis that birthed mariachis and dishes like chili con carne.

cinevault.us.title: Fun With Dick and Jane
cinevault.us.description: After Dick Harper (Jim Carrey) loses his job at Globodyne in an Enron-esque collapse, he and his wife, Jane (Téa Leoni), turn to crime in order to handle the massive debt they now face. Two intelligent people, Dick and Jane actually get pretty good at robbing people and even enjoy it -- but they have second thoughts when they're reminded that crime can hurt innocent people. When the couple hears that Globodyne boss Jack McCallister (Alec Baldwin) actually swindled the company, they plot revenge. (Comedy, Crime drama, Movie, Romance) - 2005-12-21

cinevault.us.title: The Interview
cinevault.us.description: Dave Skylark (James Franco) and his producer Aaron Rapoport (Seth Rogen) are the team behind the popular tabloid-TV show "Skylark Tonight." After learning that North Korea's Kim Jong-un (Randall Park) is a huge fan of the show, they successfully set up an interview with him, hoping to legitimize themselves as actual journalists. However, as Dave and Aaron prepare for their journey to Pyongyang, the CIA steps in, recruits them, and assigns them an incredible mission: Assassinate the dictator. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Movie) - 2014-12-25

cinevault.us.title: Did You Hear About the Morgans?
cinevault.us.description: New Yorkers Paul (Hugh Grant) and Meryl (Sarah Jessica Parker) Morgan seem to have it all -- except that their marriage is crumbling around them. But their romantic woes are small compared to the trouble they find themselves in after witnessing a murder. To protect them from an assassin, federal agents whisk away Paul and Meryl to a small town in Wyoming, where their marriage will crash and burn, or their passion will reignite. (Comedy, Movie, Romantic comedy) - 2009-12-18

cinevault.us.title: Life Without Dick
cinevault.us.description: After consulting a fortuneteller, painter Colleen (Sarah Jessica Parker) begins to suspect that her private-eye boyfriend, Dick (Johnny Knoxville), is cheating. When she comes home and finds him packing to leave her, Colleen accidentally kills him. Nervous Irish Mafia hit man Daniel (Harry Connick Jr.), who's been gunning for Dick, arrives shortly afterward and admits he has never successfully completed a job. Daniel proposes to take credit for the murder, and the odd couple fall in love. (Movie, Romantic comedy) - 2001

cinevault.us.title: I Dreamed of Africa
cinevault.us.description: Inspired by the true story of indomitable Kuki Gallmann, the film tells of a beautiful and inquisitive woman who had the courage to escape from her comfortable yet monotonous life in Italy to start anew in the African wilderness with her son, Emanuele, and her new husband, Paolo. Gallmann faces great danger there but eventually becomes a celebrated conservationist. (Drama, Movie) - 2000-05-05

cinevault.us.title: Places in the Heart
cinevault.us.description: In 1935 rural Texas, recently widowed Edna Spalding struggles to survive with two small children, a farm to run and very little money in the bank -- not to mention a deadly tornado and the unwelcome presence of the Ku Klux Klan. Edna is aided by her beautician sister, Margaret; a blind boarder, Mr. Will; and a would-be thief, Moze, who decides to stick around to teach Edna how to plant and harvest cotton. (Drama, Movie) - 1984-09-21

cinevault.us.title: Murphy's Romance
cinevault.us.description: Emma (Sally Field), a divorced single mother seeking to start her life over, moves to a small town in Arizona. She builds a relationship with Murphy (James Garner), the older local pharmacist but, due to his age, it remains platonic. Their friendship becomes complicated when Emma's ex-husband, Bobby Jack (Brian Kerwin), shows up. He claims to have changed his ways, but when he turns out to be the same man Emma divorced, she discovers her true feelings for Murphy. (Movie, Romantic comedy) - 1985

cinevault.us.title: America's Sweethearts
cinevault.us.description: For an awkward, self-conscious girl like Kiki (Julia Roberts), being the personal assistant to a beautiful megastar like Gwen (Catherine Zeta-Jones) isn't easy. But when she dutifully accepts the task of helping Gwen and her estranged husband Eddie (John Cusack) make it through one last public appearance masterminded by legendary press agent Lee Phillips (Billy Crystal), forever devoted Kiki finds that her job is about to get even harder when her and Eddie's relationship takes a romantic turn. filmriseaction.us.title: Freejack
filmriseaction.us.description: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. filmriseaction.us.title: The 51st State

Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American. (Action, Comedy) - 2001

filmriseaction.us.title: Freejack

filmriseaction.us.description: Secret agent Kristoff (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is assigned to escort Galina Konstantin (Laura Elena Harring), a thief in possession of a deadly virus, on a train journey that unluckily falls on his birthday. Kristoff tells his disappointed wife, son and daughter that he's taking a business trip. They decide to sneak aboard the train as a surprise, only to suspect he's having an affair with the mysterious Galina. To make matters much worse, terrorists hijack the train and go after the virus. (Action, Thriller) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: The Contract
filmriseaction.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Assault on Precinct 13
filmriseaction.us.description: When the LAPD kills several members of the South Central gang Street Thunder, the remaining members avenge themselves by way of a bloody war waged against cops and citizens alike. Caught in the crossfire is Lt. Ethan Bishop (Austin Stoker), who's managing a skeleton crew at the local and soon-to-be-closed police precinct. As the gang members close in, Bishop forms an unlikely alliance with a group of prisoners in order to defend the station and the lives of everyone in it. (Action) - 1976

filmriseaction.us.title: In Hell
filmriseaction.us.description: Kyle LeBlanc is an honorable citizen who winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife, resulting in the killer's death. Unfortunately for Kyle, he is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt and sadistic warden, the facility regularly holds brutal fights between inmates. In order to survive in the prison, Kyle must participate in the battles, even as he attempts to retain his humanity. (Action) - 2003

filmriseaction.us.title: K-19: The Widowmaker

His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men. (Thriller, Historical drama, War) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Eye See You

He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one. (Thriller) - 2002

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Footprints in the Snow
dateline.us.description: The missing-persons case of 12-year-old Jonelle Matthews in Colorado remained a mystery for more than three decades until detectives narrowed in on a suspect whose bizarre behavior after her disappearance hinted at something much more sinister.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Sisterhood
dateline.us.description: After the cause of the death of Stacy Feldman in her Denver home is ruled as undetermined, friends and family join forces to piece together what happened; insiders close to the case speak out about the seven-year battle for justice.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - A Cool Desert Morning
dateline.us.description: A family begins a relentless pursuit of justice after the death of Nevada attorney Susan Winters is ruled a suicide; Susan's parents open up about the seven-year case and their efforts to push back against the criminal justice system.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - On the Outskirts of Town
dateline.us.description: When a young woman is found dead near a soccer field in Indiana, detectives try to piece together a puzzle that leads them to an unexpected suspect.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Pin at Apartment 210
dateline.us.description: A young Tennessee woman mysteriously vanishes and misses her family's Thanksgiving dinner; determined to track her down, her family takes matters into their own hands, pursuing every digital clue she left behind.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Unusual Suspect
dateline.us.description: Police suspect a serial killer when two women and their teenage daughters are murdered in Maryland; during the search for clues, it's revealed that a master thief is the key to solving the mystery.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Motive
dateline.us.description: When a young woman finds out that her boyfriend might have shot and killed a college football player out of revenge, she struggles with coming forward to officials, fearing she could lose her life.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - While She Was Sleeping
dateline.us.description: The residents of a glamorous resort town are shocked when a well-known woman from a prominent family is found dead in her home.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Deadly Valentine
dateline.us.description: A mother of three married to a missionary is found dead on Valentine's Day; the investigation into the murder reveals answers close to home.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Accused
dateline.us.description: A man who was recently acquitted of the murder of his ex-girlfriend's 12-year-old son tells his story; interview with the victim's mother and key players in the case.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Long Road to Freedom
dateline.us.description: Two Tulsa brothers fight for more than 20 years to prove their innocence after they were wrongfully convicted for separate murders.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Queen of the County
dateline.us.description: A matriarch's death leads to a prominent family from Texas being torn apart by decades of betrayal, greed and mistrust.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Robert Durst: The Lost Years
dateline.us.description: Friends of accused murderer Robert Durst talk about his recent arrest in New Orleans and his whereabouts over the past 30 years.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Ultimatum
dateline.us.description: A mother's death initially appears to be a suicide, but when investigators start to interview those closest to her, an evil plot emerges.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Mystery in Big Sky Country
dateline.us.description: When a young, handsome veterinarian is found dead in his home in Montana, the mystery remains unsolved for nearly two decades.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Favorite Son
dateline.us.description: A couple is murdered shortly after their wedding and police suspect a family feud is the cause; Josh Mankiewicz looks back at what started the dispute that left him floored.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S28 E05 Jason and Karun test two new sports SUVs, while Vicki checks out a 3.6l V6 turbocharged American muscle costing a cool £500,000: the ultra-exclusive Ford GT.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S28 E07 Jonny and Vicki test Audi's first electric model, the e-tron SUV, versus the Tesla Model X. Vicki looks at second-hand electric cars.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S28 E09 This collection of Fifth Gear Shoot-Outs sees Jason Plato put classic iconic cars up against their modern alternatives.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S28 E10 Jonny and Jimmy are in Korea to find out how they made world-beating cars in just a few years; Jimmy revisits the original Bentley Blower; Jason hits the track in an Alpine A110.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S01 E03 Adrian Simpson road tests the new Hyundai Coupé.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S01 E04 The new Ford Focus ST170 hatchback.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S01 E05 Tiff tests the Pagani Zonda; Quentin investigates the second-hand BMW market; Adrian discovers the vehicle for the style-conscious celebrity.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S01 E06 Tiff Needell tests the new MG TF; Quentin Willson reveals some ways people try to get off their speeding tickets.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S01 E08 Adrian drives the Renault VelSatis; Quentin shows the benefits of liquefied petroleum gas; Vicki tests the Audi A4 Cabriolet.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S02 E02 Tiff Needell wants to know the best GT car you can buy for £90,000; the Mercedes SL55 AMG and the Porsche 911 Turbo.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S02 E03 Adrian Simpson test drives Volvo's new off-roader; he concludes because of their attention to safety, the environment and the family-size accommodation, Volvo has created a different kind of 4x4.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S02 E05 Vicki Butler-Henderson, Adrian Simpson and Tom Ford visit the Paris motor show; new models revealed there including the Porsche Cayenne and Bentley Continental GT.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S02 E06 Tiff Needell travels to California to test drive Nissan's new 350Z sports car; Adrian Simpson goes for a parallel parking tutorial with Britain's leading stunt driver; Quentin Willson reports on the state of the used car market.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S02 E07 Multi-millionaire John Caudwell, the boss of a mobile phone company, has a budget of £500,000 to spend on new cars, and he's come to Fifth Gear for some advice on what motors to choose.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S02 E08 Tom Ford tests Nissan's new Micra; he finds it well-made and easy to drive; Adrian Simpson goes in search of haunted cars; he starts by being skeptical that haunted cars can exist at all.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S03 E01 Quentin and Tiff stage a head-on-collision with two remote-controlled cars; Tom tries out the Jaguar XJ.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S03 E03 Roll-Over Tiff and Vicki demonstrate how easy it is to roll a 4 by 4.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E04 The Admirer Louisa Glasson finds out she has a rival for Doc Martin's affections; Martin accidentally runs over a dog.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E07 Happily Ever After Martin needs to find a replacement vicar just three hours before the wedding; bridesmaid Isobel goes into labor.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E06 Midwife Crisis Doc clashes with the new district midwife over natural methods; Bert becomes enamored with a new restaurant employee.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E07 Do Not Disturb Pauline finds out Doc is leaving; Bert organizes a baby shower for Louisa; Doc and Edith go to a conference.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S05 E01 Preserve the Romance Martin Ellingham's plans to resume his career are put on hold with the birth of a baby; the new GP misdiagnoses a patient.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S05 E02 Dry Your Tears Doc Martin has to deal with the death of his Aunt Joan, demands of fatherhood, and the arrival of his Aunt Ruth.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S05 E03 Born With a Shotgun Martin's new receptionist makes a poor first impression; Louisa and Martin find sleepless nights are taking their toll.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S05 E04 Mother Knows Best Portwenn Fun Day has the villagers abuzz; Martin and Louisa are not happy when Louisa's mother arrives unexpectedly.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S05 E06 Don't Let Go Joe Penhale is desperate to show Maggie he has changed; Martin has to rescue Mr. Coley from a rooftop.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S05 E07 Cats and Sharks Bert Large's restaurant is in financial trouble, and he is unable to help with the charity event for Florence Dingle's cat sanctuary.

moviesphere.us.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
moviesphere.us.description: After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science fiction) - 2013-11-21

moviesphere.us.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
moviesphere.us.description: Following her rescue from the devastating Quarter Quell, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) awakes in the complex beneath the supposedly destroyed District 13. Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science fiction) - 2014-11-08

moviesphere.us.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
moviesphere.us.description: Realizing the stakes are no longer just for survival, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) teams up with her closest friends, including Peeta (Josh Hutcherson), Gale (Liam Hemsworth) and Finnick for the ultimate mission. Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science fiction) - 2015-11-18

moviesphere.us.title: The Hunger Games
moviesphere.us.description: In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2012-03-22

After Sonny accepts a deal with Seattle that nets him that team's first-round pick, he immediately wonders if he has made the right choice for himself and the Browns. (Drama, Movie) - 2014-04-11

moviesphere.us.title: Buried

Faced with a dwindling oxygen supply and a dying battery, Paul must fight panic, despair and delirium as he awaits a rescue that might not arrive in time. outlaw.us.title: Firecreek
outlaw.us.description: Johnny Cobb (James Stewart) is the part-time sheriff in a small, rundown town, trying to stretch his meager salary to provide for his growing family. Poor Cobb isn't much of a gunman, and he isn't particularly suited for fighting, but he's the man in charge when a gang of bandits led by Bob Larkin (Henry Fonda) rides into town. The tension rises as the bandits make themselves at home in Cobb's town, but when a gunfight breaks out, Cobb finds himself pushed to the limit. (Western) - 1968

outlaw.us.title: Tension at Table Rock
outlaw.us.description: When locals are wrongfully led to believe that Wes Tancred murdered a gunslinger in cold blood, they exile the innocent man. Tancred sets off in search of a new start and arrives in the dusty hamlet of Table Rock -- only to find his reputation has preceded him. To avoid trouble, Tancred uses an assumed name. But, when Sheriff Fred Miller talks of trouble at the hands of a violent gang, Tancred agrees to be deputized, and struggles for his shot at redemption. (Western) - 1956

outlaw.us.title: Guns of Diablo
outlaw.us.description: A wagon master is confronted by a man he wounded years before in episodes from "The Travels of Jamie McPheeters." (Western) - 1964

outlaw.us.title: Forsaken
outlaw.us.description: In 1872 Wyoming, a former gunslinger (Kiefer Sutherland) and his estranged father (Donald Sutherland) encounter a ruthless businessman (Brian Cox) and his gang of thugs. (Western, Drama) - 2015

outlaw.us.title: Kung Fu: The Movie
outlaw.us.description: Searching for a peaceful life in 1885 Sacramento, Calif., Caine is stalked by opium traders and a vengeful Manchu lord. (Western) - 1986

outlaw.us.title: King of the Wild Stallions
outlaw.us.description: A ranch foreman (George Montgomery) saves a widow (Diane Brewster) from a cattle baron by catching a prize stallion. (Western) - 1959

outlaw.us.title: The Lawless Frontier
outlaw.us.description: The parents of John Tobin (John Wayne) have been murdered, and he wants justice. He sets out to find the killer, the evil gang leader Pandro Zanti (Earl Dwire), who hides from the law with disguises and almost kills old prospector Dusty (George Hayes) and his granddaughter. John rescues them and catches Zanti, only to face criminal charges from lawman Sheriff Williams (Jack Rockwell). Zanti is let go, and John must clear his name and establish who the real criminal is. (Western) - 1935

outlaw.us.title: Angel and the Badman
outlaw.us.description: Quirt Evans (John Wayne), a cowboy on the run, is injured when his horse stumbles near a Quaker family's land. The family takes him in as he regains his health, and he falls for their young daughter, Penelope (Gail Russell). As Quirt falls deeper in love and becomes accustomed to the family's peaceful ways, his violent past starts to catch up to him. Eventually he is forced to decide whether it is worth letting go of his turbulent former life for his future with Penelope. (Western) - 1947

outlaw.us.title: Last Stand at Saber River
outlaw.us.description: A Confederate soldier (Tom Selleck) returns to his Arizona homestead and finds Union sympathizers have laid claim to his land. (Western) - 1997

outtvproud.us.title: The Messengers
outtvproud.us.description: When the Solomons trade in the craziness of big-city life for the quiet of a North Dakota farm, little do they expect the nightmare that follows. Soon after arriving, teenage Jess (Kristen Stewart) and her younger brother see terrifying apparitions and endure attacks from a supernatural source. Jess must warn her disbelieving family before it is too late to save them. (Horror, Thriller) - 2007

outtvproud.us.title: Messengers 2: The Scarecrow

outtvproud.us.title: Boogeyman

Despite the reassurances of his mother (Lucy Lawless) that the boogeyman is not real, he is never the same afterward. Years later, Tim (Barry Watson) manages to create a normal life for himself -- though he lives without closets and keeps his mattress on the floor. But when he learns of his mother's death, Tim must return home to face his childhood trauma. (Horror, Thriller) - 2005

paranormalfiles.us.description: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

truehistory.us.title: From Jesus to Constantine: A History of Early Christianity - The Religious World of Early Christianity
truehistory.us.description: This lecture introduces the pagan, polytheistic religions that dominate the early world; the most important Roman religion for the birth of Christianity; Judaism, the religion of Jesus and his followers. (Educational, History, Religious) - 2004-01-26

truehistory.us.title: From Jesus to Constantine: A History of Early Christianity - The Historical Jesus
truehistory.us.description: In the first of three lectures on the birth of Christianity, Professor Ehrman examines the life of Jesus of Nazareth; referred to both outside the New Testament and within the Gospels themselves. (Educational, History, Religious) - 2004-01-26

truehistory.us.title: From Jesus to Constantine: A History of Early Christianity - Oral and Written Traditions about Jesus
truehistory.us.description: How four anonymous authors who live decades after Jesus record traditions that have been circulating orally over the intervening years; examining the extent to which those traditions have been modified in the retelling. (Educational, History, Religious) - 2004-01-26

truehistory.us.title: The History of the Bible: The Making of the New Testament Canon - The New Testament-An Overview
truehistory.us.description: The course begins by addressing some of the basic facts about the New Testament; which books it contains, when they are written, in what language and by whom. (Educational) - 2005-10-03

truehistory.us.title: The History of the Bible: The Making of the New Testament Canon - Paul-Our Earliest Christian Author
truehistory.us.description: The Epistles of Paul are the earliest books of the New Testament, predating even the Gospels; the realities of writing a letter in the ancient world; issues that affect how one understands Paul's Epistles and the other writings of the New Testament. (Educational) - 2005-10-03

truehistory.us.title: The History of the Bible: The Making of the New Testament Canon - The Pauline Epistles
truehistory.us.description: This lecture looks at some of the major teachings of Paul's Epistles; showing how he shapes his theological and ethical views in light of the problems that emerge in his burgeoning Christian communities. (Educational) - 2005-10-03

truehistory.us.title: The History of the Bible: The Making of the New Testament Canon - The Problem of Pseudonymity
truehistory.us.description: This lecture considers the broad problem of pseudonymity, or forgery, in the ancient world; applying one's findings to the Pauline letters of the New Testament to see if any, in fact, are written by Paul's followers rather than Paul himself. (Educational) - 2005-10-03

truehistory.us.title: The History of Christianity: From the Disciples to the Dawn of the Reformation - The Historical Study of Christianity
truehistory.us.description: The historical trajectory of Christianity; contemporary ignorance of its past; considering the value of the historical study of Christianity; looking at the methods and role of the historian; the sources and limitations of historical knowledge. (Educational, Religious, History) - 2012-11-17

truehistory.us.title: The History of Christianity: From the Disciples to the Dawn of the Reformation - The First Cultural Context - Greece and Rome
truehistory.us.description: Investigating the culture of the Mediterranean world in which Christianity is born; the legacy of Alexander; the features of Greek politics, religion and philosophy; learning about the nature of Roman rule and imperial order in the region. (Educational, Religious, History) - 2012-11-17

truehistory.us.title: The History of Christianity: From the Disciples to the Dawn of the Reformation - The First Cultural Context - Judaism
truehistory.us.description: The circumstances of Jewish life in ancient Palestine and the diaspora; examining cultural and ideological factors that divide the Jews; the tensions they face between assimilation and separation; their resistance to Greek culture and Roman rule. (Educational, Religious, History) - 2012-11-17

truehistory.us.title: The History of Christianity: From the Disciples to the Dawn of the Reformation - The Jesus Movement and the Birth of Christianity
truehistory.us.description: Considering the resurrection as marking the birth of Christianity, as rooted in the claims of the first believers; assessing the contradiction between Jesus as the source of divine life and the degrading manner of his death. (Educational, Religious, History) - 2012-11-17

truehistory.us.title: How Jesus Became God - Jesus - The Man Who Became God
truehistory.us.description: The historical significance of the Christian belief in Jesus's divinity, in terms of its effects on Western civilization; learning about different scholarly views of the historical Jesus; tracing the diversity of early Christian thought. (Educational, History, Religious) - 2014-07-25

truehistory.us.title: How Jesus Became God - Greco-Roman Gods Who Became Human
truehistory.us.description: The accounts of divine mortals in the ancient world; the overlap between the human and divine worlds in Greco-Roman polytheistic religions; exploring three age-old models of divine men in both mythology and Christian scripture. (Educational, History, Religious) - 2014-07-25

truehistory.us.title: How Jesus Became God - Humans as Gods in the Greco-Roman World
truehistory.us.description: Delving into the interface between the human and the divine in pagan cultures; examining narratives describing people born of the sexual union of gods with mortals; looking at cases of humans who were exalted to the status of gods. (Educational, History, Religious) - 2014-07-25

truehistory.us.title: How Jesus Became God - Gods Who Were Human in Ancient Judaism
truehistory.us.description: Accounts of divine humans and other godlike beings within ancient Judaism; exploring conceptions of divine beings that appear in human form in Genesis and Exodus; studying narratives of humans who become angelic beings in other Jewish texts. (Educational, History, Religious) - 2014-07-25

truehistory.us.title: From Jesus to Constantine: A History of Early Christianity - The Birth of Christianity
truehistory.us.description: This lecture introduces some issues essential to understanding how Christianity begins; growing away from its Jewish roots; ultimately becoming the most important religion of the civilization. (Educational, History, Religious) - 2004-01-26

truehistory.us.title: From Jesus to Constantine: A History of Early Christianity - The Religious World of Early Christianity
truehistory.us.description: This lecture introduces the pagan, polytheistic religions that dominate the early world; the most important Roman religion for the birth of Christianity; Judaism, the religion of Jesus and his followers. (Educational, History, Religious) - 2004-01-26

truehistory.us.title: From Jesus to Constantine: A History of Early Christianity - The Historical Jesus
truehistory.us.description: In the first of three lectures on the birth of Christianity, Professor Ehrman examines the life of Jesus of Nazareth; referred to both outside the New Testament and within the Gospels themselves. (Educational, History, Religious) - 2004-01-26

truehistory.us.title: From Jesus to Constantine: A History of Early Christianity - Oral and Written Traditions about Jesus
truehistory.us.description: How four anonymous authors who live decades after Jesus record traditions that have been circulating orally over the intervening years; examining the extent to which those traditions have been modified in the retelling. (Educational, History, Religious) - 2004-01-26

truehistory.us.title: The History of the Bible: The Making of the New Testament Canon - The New Testament-An Overview
truehistory.us.description: The course begins by addressing some of the basic facts about the New Testament; which books it contains, when they are written, in what language and by whom. (Educational) - 2005-10-03

truehistory.us.title: The History of the Bible: The Making of the New Testament Canon - Paul-Our Earliest Christian Author
truehistory.us.description: The Epistles of Paul are the earliest books of the New Testament, predating even the Gospels; the realities of writing a letter in the ancient world; issues that affect how one understands Paul's Epistles and the other writings of the New Testament. (Educational) - 2005-10-03

truehistory.us.title: The History of the Bible: The Making of the New Testament Canon - The Pauline Epistles
truehistory.us.description: This lecture looks at some of the major teachings of Paul's Epistles; showing how he shapes his theological and ethical views in light of the problems that emerge in his burgeoning Christian communities. (Educational) - 2005-10-03

truehistory.us.title: The History of the Bible: The Making of the New Testament Canon - The Problem of Pseudonymity
truehistory.us.description: This lecture considers the broad problem of pseudonymity, or forgery, in the ancient world; applying one's findings to the Pauline letters of the New Testament to see if any, in fact, are written by Paul's followers rather than Paul himself. (Educational) - 2005-10-03

truehistory.us.title: The History of Christianity: From the Disciples to the Dawn of the Reformation - The Historical Study of Christianity
truehistory.us.description: The historical trajectory of Christianity; contemporary ignorance of its past; considering the value of the historical study of Christianity; looking at the methods and role of the historian; the sources and limitations of historical knowledge. (Educational, Religious, History) - 2012-11-17

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Hand-Crafted Pasta in Puglia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads for one of the hottest food destinations in Italy, making hand-crafted pasta, a special seafood stew, and the region's answer to paella. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Masterclass In Sicilian Sweets
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Jalisco Style Birria

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Cantina Culture and the Morning After?

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - A Day With Hugo

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Double Vallarta
tastemadetravel.us.description: Chef Thierry Blouet offers a tour of Puerto Vallarta's street food; La Docena restaurant; the ins and outs of one of Nuevo Vallarta's biggest resort destinations. (Cooking) - 2021-11-10

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Tuscan Farmhouse Classics
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Roasting Hilltop Lamb in Basilicata
