thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E11 Final Reckoning: You're the Worst Tensions boil over between Cara Maria and the Lavender Ladies, leaving Marie in the middle of her friends and her vendetta partner; at the "Sky Bridge" challenge, the players must rebuild both their trust and a perilous rope bridge.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E12 Final Reckoning: Unhappy Days One player is shaken when their partner hurls an unforgivable insult at them; the players find themselves locked up and puzzled at the "Caged In challenge"; at the "Tread Lightly Elimination," a shocking match-up has tremendous impact.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E13 Final Reckoning: The People vs. Johnny Bananas A plot by the Lavender Ladies and Team Young Buck to topple Johnny Bananas spins wildly out of control, resulting in the most shocking elimination of the season so far.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E14 Final Reckoning: Lavender Is the New Black After the results of the last wild elimination, the Lavender Ladies' loyalty toward one another is put to the test; Sylvia headbutts Marie...really.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E15 Final Reckoning: Wheel of Fortune Bananas and Tony struggle with being the odd men out in the game; twists in the Double Cross leads to a twisted plan that blows up in one team's face; two results of the elimination round send shock waves through the game.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E16 Final Reckoning: The Leftovers A debaucherous night ends in total chaos as simmering tensions throughout the game finally boil over; the players face off in "Hit List," where their trivia skills are put to the test.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E17 Final Reckoning: Scandal Rumors and gossip become one team's secret weapon when their backs are against the wall; surprising outcomes at the "Heads Will Roll" challenge have lasting implications on the game.

thechallenge.us.title: The Challenge
thechallenge.us.description: S32 E18 Final Reckoning: It's Always Sunny in South Africa The Redemption House erupts when enemies come face to face; a season-long grudge match is finally settled when two power-house teams must battle for survival; players compete in the "Rolling Thunder" challenge.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E04 Stained Glass Studio Couple Farzana & Reyan have maxed out all living space in their city-sized bungalow, leaving no room for Reyan's at-home stained-glass business or Farzana's writing. Brian and Sarah build Reyan a spacious studio and construct an inspiring deck area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E02 Nana's Wonderland Janet's love for her nine grandkids is endless. But so is the chaos they bring inside her home when they come visit. To take that energy outside, Brian and Sarah build a fun kid-zone in the backyard, but also a sophisticated adult area for Janet.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E04 Country Supper Club & Coop Ex-city slickers, Lauren and Mark, miss their friends and family from the city. Brian and Sarah create a country retreat with an outdoor pad, indoor dining lounge, and a chicken coop. When Lauren and Mark's friends visit, they'll never want to leave.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E05 Gentleman's Gym Mom and son duo, Paul and Catharine, are overwhelmed by Paul's multi-level backyard. Paul also finds his current indoor fitness regime frustrating. Brian and Sarah muscle up to the challenge by building a gym in his backyard, alongside a hot tub.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Pub Paradise Bachelor Kyle's father Jack has helped him renovate his new home, but the backyard is still unusable. To help Kyle throw the ultimate housewarming party, Brian and Sarah build a sexy sports pub, a lounge area and a fire pit.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 Twins Clubhouse Sham, Ruban and their twin boys aren't using their big, boring backyard. To help this family embrace the great outdoors, Brian and Sarah build a vacation style getaway, with a beach volleyball court and a kid's clubhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Rustic Barn Rehab Becki, Shawn and their 3 kids just moved from the city to a smaller country home. To extend their living space, Brian and Sarah build a new deck, a fire pit area, and a 3-season living space, in their first ever barn rehab.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E05 Wellness Wonderland Breanna & Nick's life revolves around socializing and physical activity. Brian and Sarah convert an old, underused shed into a beautiful, zen'd out yoga studio and create backyard partying, lounging and dining areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E10 Mid-Century Poolside Retreat Amy & Terry love nothing more than spending time outside with their daughters. Brian and Sarah build a dream enclosure to hang out in on summer nights, with a swimming pool change room and a new deck where Terry can grill.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E04 Tropical Family Resort Tammy and Sam are so busy, their backyard has fallen into disrepair and their 2 kids never use it. Brian and Sarah bring this yard back to life, and then some, with a new dining and lounge area and a fully functional pool house.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E08 Craft Studio Jenn and Josh don't have enough space in their semi-detached home to enjoy their hobbies. Brian and Sarah build a stylish lounge space and convert the existing garage into a multipurpose space for crafting and playing guitar.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E13 Hillside Playhouse Matt, Mary and their 2 kids don't use their backyard because the neighboring ravine has taken over. Brian and Sarah face environmental challenges to create a beautiful, entertaining and play space for the whole family to enjoy.

tastemadehome.us.title: Grand Designs
tastemadehome.us.description: S19 E02 Geometric Mega House In South Devon, Joe and Claire's family house will be a giant sculpture inspired by the local landscape, 70 meters long and featuring 34 enormous angled zinc shards jutting out in all directions. But it proves astonishingly complicated to build.

tastemadehome.us.title: Grand Designs
tastemadehome.us.description: S19 E04 Modern Country Estate On a Scottish country estate architect Lain and his wife Jenny build an enormous new black, square building inside a beautiful old walled garden, connecting it right through the high garden wall into a dilapidated gardeners' bothy on the other side.

tastemadehome.us.title: Grand Designs
tastemadehome.us.description: S19 E05 Malaysian Glass Pavilion Bereaved Gretta returns from Malaysia to build a single-story, burnt wood and glass pavilion on the land of her sister Mary and brother-in-law Fernando. Also designed by her nephew Carlos, it's a real family affair, a story of recovery and renewal.

tastemadehome.us.title: Grand Designs
tastemadehome.us.description: S19 E06 Sleek Waterscape Build Architectural designer Dan and interior designer Nina want to build a sleek, unique larch clad family house. But their biggest challenge is to convert a swamp on the plot into a sweeping, biodiverse waterscape with a beautiful natural swimming pond.

tastemadehome.us.title: Grand Designs
tastemadehome.us.description: S19 E08 Dramatic Cantilevered House Ex-advertising man Geoff builds a dramatically cantilevered house on a flood plain in Essex. It's one of the challenges of his life: a flood resistant architectural marvel on the coast, designed to survive a one in a thousand-year flood event.

tastemadehome.us.title: Grand Designs

classica.us.title: Mozarts Sinfonie Nr. 34 und Dvořáks Sinfonie Nr. 7
classica.us.description: Iván Fischer dirigiert das Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in diesem Konzert. Eröffnet wird das Programm mit Mozarts Sinfonie Nr. 34 in C-Dur, KV 338. Diese Sinfonie war die letzte, die Mozart in Salzburg als Hofmusiker schrieb. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2024-10-18

classica.us.title: Teatro Regio - Hinter den Kulissen
classica.us.description: Das Teatro Regio wurde 1740 mit der Aufführung eines Werkes von Francesco Feo eröffnet. Eine Blütezeit erlebte das Haus von 1895 bis 1898 unter der Leitung von Arturo Toscanini. 1896 fand dort die Uraufführung von Puccinis "La Bohème" statt. (Special, Documentary, Music, Classical, Opera) - 2017-06-01

classica.us.title: Hollywood-Gala - Preisverleihungsnacht
classica.us.description: Das Dänische Nationale Sinfonieorchester und der Konzertchor entführen Sie auf eine musikalische Reise durch die größten Oscar-prämierten Filme. (Special, Music) - 2026-09-12

classica.us.title: Chopin - Nocturnes Op. 62
classica.us.description: Roberto Prosseda (1975) spielt Mozarts 5. Klaviersonate und vier Impromptus, Op. 90 von Franz Schubert. Prosseda bringt das Konzert mit einer Interpretation des technisch anspruchsvollen Ballade No. 4, Op. 52 von Chopin zu einem krönenden Abschluss. Er ist besonders für seine Interpretationen einiger kürzlich entdeckter Werke von Mendelssohn und seine 9-teilige CD-Serie über Klavierwerke des Komponisten bekannt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-12-15

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
classica.us.description: Die Mezzosopranistin Magdalena Kožená und der Tenor Andrew Staples schließen sich Sir Simon Rattle an, um den Zyklus "Das Lied von der Erde" von Gustav Mahler zu Gehör zu bringen. Das Konzert fand am 9. Mai 2021 im Barbican Centre in London statt. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-12-06

classica.us.title: Bach - 6. Brandenburgisches Konzert
classica.us.description: Bei dieser Aufführung im Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses präsentieren Václav Luks und sein Collegium 1704 Bachs Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 6 in B-Dur, BWV 1051. Im Gegensatz zu den anderen Konzerten gibt es in diesem Stück keine Geigen. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-06-18

classica.us.title: Werke von Beethoven und Saint-Saëns
classica.us.description: Im Jahr 2021 feiert Martha Argerich ihren 80. Geburtstag mit einem Konzert im Château de Chantilly, Frankreich. Bei diesem Konzert wird Argerich von dem Cellisten Mischa Maisky, dem Geiger Maxim Vengerov und dem Pianisten Iddo Bar-Shaï begleitet. (Music, Concert, Classical) - 2024-12-06

classica.us.title: Ueda -- Someone Out There Is Praying for Peace I
classica.us.description: Andrea Vitello dirigiert die Komposition "Someone Out There is Praying for Peace" der zeitgenössischen Komponistin Rita Ueda. Das Werk ist für Streicher und Tar, ein traditionelles Zupfinstrument der persischen Musik, geschrieben. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-10-01

classica.us.title: Wer hat das Boléro von Maurice Ravel gestohlen?
classica.us.description: In der Dokumentation wird der Rechtsstreit um das Musikstück Boléro untersucht. Das Stück wird von Maurice Ravel im Jahr 1928 komponiert und dieser gibt die Rechte an seinen Bruder Edouard. Dieser stirbt 1960 und löst den Rechtsstreit aus. (Special, Documentary) - 2016-05-01

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Klaviersonate Nr. 21 - III
classica.us.description: Julijana Sarac spielt den dritten Satz aus Ludwig van Beethovens Klaviersonate Nr. 21. (Special, Music) - 2023-05-02

classica.us.title: Hans van Manen: Moving to Music
classica.us.description: Reflexionen von Freunden und Kollegen, die Details der Choreographie von Hans van Manen enthüllen. (Special, Documentary, Dance, Ballet)

classica.us.title: Bach - Sonate Nr. 2 BWV 1015
classica.us.description: Die Sonate Nr. 2 BWV 1018 ist die zweite von Bachs Sonaten, die vor 1725 komponiert wurden. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2021-07-04

classica.us.title: Holst - Die Planeten
classica.us.description: Conrad van Alphen dirigiert die Sinfonia Rotterdam und den Nationaal Vrouwen Jeugdkoor in einer Aufführung von Gustav Holsts The Planets, Op. 32, aufgenommen in De Doelen, Rotterdam, im Jahr 2019. Van Alphen gründete Sinfonia Rotterdam im Jahr 2000. (Special, Performing arts) - 2007-04-26

classica.us.title: Werke für Violine und Klavier: Corelli, Ravel u.a
classica.us.description: Der japanische Geiger Naoya Nishimura und der italienische Pianist Andrea Bacchetti präsentieren ein intimes Recital, das in der Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan, aufgenommen wurde. Diese Aufführung wurde am 22. Juni 2019 aufgenommen. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-01-01

classica.us.title: Schumann - 1. Klaviersonate in fis-Moll, op. 11
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Schwartz Schumanns Klaviersonate Nr. 1 in fis-Moll, op. 11. Schumann vollendete das Werk im Jahr 1835 und widmete es seiner Geliebten Clara Wieck. Da er sie nicht sehen durfte, schickte er Clara die Sonate anonym. (Special) - 2024-01-30

classica.us.title: Gershwin - Greatest Hits
classica.us.description: Der belgische Dirigent Jos van Immerseel leitet Anima Eterna Brugge in einem Konzertprogramm, das dem amerikanischen Komponisten George Gershwin gewidmet ist. Die Aufführung wurde am 3. März 2017 im Concertgebouw Brügge, Belgien, aufgezeichnet. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2024-02-12

classica.us.title: Chopin - Ballade Nr. 1, Op. 23
classica.us.description: Der Musiker Roberto Giordano interpretiert Chopins Ballade Nr. 1, Op. 23. Bereits aus 1831 stammen erste Entwürfe dieses Werks. Der Komponist hielt sich damals in Wien auf. Jedoch wurde die erste Ballade erst 1835 in Paris vollendet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-06-12

classica.us.title: Anastasia
classica.us.description: Anlässlich des 100-jährigen Jubiläums der magischen Geschichte um die russische Großfürstin Anastasia bringt das kanadische Ballett Jörgen 2019 ihre zehn Jahre alte Produktion zurück auf die Bühne! "Anastasia" wurde vom gefeierten Choreografen und künstlerischen Leiter Bengt Jörgen kreiert und ist mit einer originalen Orchesterpartitur des Komponisten Ivan Barbotin unterlegt. (Special, Music) - 2021-08-19

classica.us.title: Werke von Smetana, Janáček, Suk und Dvořák
classica.us.description: Mit diesem Kammermusikprogramm zollen die Musiker der Reina Sofía Musikschule in Madrid der Musik der größten tschechischen Komponisten Tribut. Auf dem Programm stehen Werke von Smetana, Janáček, Dvořák und Suk. Das Konzert fand am 28.11.2024 statt. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-12-23

classica.us.title: Mahler, Symphonie Nr. 1 D-Dur
classica.us.description: Die Wiener Philharmoniker unter der Leitung von Leonard Bernstein spielen die Symphonie Nr. 1 D-Dur von Gustav Mahler (1860-1911). Diese Aufnahme entstand im Oktober 1974 im Wiener Konzerthaus. Als erster Dirigent nahm Leonard Bernstein alle Symphonien Gustav Mahlers nicht nur auf Schallplatte, sondern auch auf Video auf. Bernsteins Mahler-Zyklus ist ein einzigartiges musikalisches Dokument und trug zu einem neuen Verständnis von Mahlers Werk bei. (Special, Music) - 2012-12-06

classica.us.title: Grieg - Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16
classica.us.description: Dirigent Jan Latham-Koenig leitet das Flanders Symphony Orchestra mit einer Aufführung von Edvard Griegs Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16. Diese Aufführung wurde am 21. April 2016 im Concertgebouw Brügge, Belgien, aufgezeichnet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-01-03

classica.us.title: Bach - 3. Sonate für Violin (BWV 1005)
classica.us.description: Isabelle Faust spielt zwei unglaubliche Solowerke für Violine von J. S. Bach: Partita Nr. 2 in d-Moll BWV 1004 und Sonate Nr. 3 in C-Dur BWV 1005. Beide Werke sind Teil der bekannten Sonaten und Solo-Partiten für Violine des Komponisten. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-05-31

10shakeperth.au.title: Rubble and Crew

When Speed Meister gets in the way, the pups spring into action. Can the pups finish building a present for Auntie Crane?

10shakeperth.au.title: Garden Academy
10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E27 How To Brush Your Teeth Let's keep our teeth clean! Margarita and Rose are going to teach Monti how we should brush our teeth to keep them clean and healthy!

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E25 Pups Save Baby Humdinger / Pups Save A Pinata During a trip to Adventure Bay, Tracker takes a nap and dreams that Mayor Humdinger has become a baby. Alex is heartbroken when his special birthday pinata mysteriously disappears.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E26 Sea Patrol: Pups Save Puplantis PAW Patrol visit the mer-pups' undersea kingdom, but Sid Swashbuckle the Pirate and his first pup mate Arrby steal the giant pearl-making shell that gives Puplantis its magic.

10shakeperth.au.title: Henry Danger
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E20 Henry Danger: The Musical Part 1 When Frankini uses a device to put a musical curse over Swellview, Kid Danger and Captain Man are forced to find a way to save everyone,.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Creature Cases
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E2 The Riddle Of Raging Rhinos / The Trouble In The Tundra What's causing the friendly rhinos to rage out at the Watering Hole hangout? // Sam and Kit are on the case when the Mice Squad goes missing in the Arctic.

10shakeperth.au.title: Pig Goat Banana Cricket
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E10 Let's Get Tiny Goat sides with some misfit paintings after being accused of stealing from a museum. Cricket helps a team of bacteria cheerleaders win their match. Banana plots to get his old boss back.

10shakeperth.au.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E6 Calling Some Monsters / Dig This After discovering the camp monsters acting too civil, SpongeBob and Patrick ask them to turn over an old leaf. / An archaeological dig escalates, uncovering a bone to pick for Sandy with Kamp Koral.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Patrick Star Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E26 Bubble Bass Reviews / Patrick's Prison Pals Bubble Bass reviews The Patrick Show. // Bunny brings Patrick to prison for Bring Your Kid To Work Day.

10shakeperth.au.title: Tyler Perry's Young Dylan
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E2 My Fair Charlie Charlie seeks Dylan's help when he has a crush on a girl, but Dylan's rap music-informed advice clashes with Rebecca's more feminist take on how Charlie should handle the situation.

10shakeperth.au.title: Tyler Perry's Young Dylan
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E3 A Tale Of Two Rappers The school's doing a hip-hop version of Shakespeare, Dylan takes on another boy for the lead role. After only being cast as an understudy, Dylan is determined to outshine his rival.

10shakeperth.au.title: Rock Paper Scissors
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E10 Pencil Comes Over / The Wind When Pencil comes over to watch a horror movie, Paper worries he'll be too scared to handle it. // There's a light wind, and Paper is far from home.

10shakeperth.au.title: Max & The Midknights
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E3 The Spirit Of The Sea As Max and the Midknights sail across the sea on their quest, they get spooked when Uncle Budrick claims there's a ghost on board their ship! Meanwhile, Mumblin fears someone is out to get him.

10shakeperth.au.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E4 The Island The Mutanimals turn on the Ninja Turtles after Ray Fillet accuses them of attacking him in Central Park! The Turtles realize a mutant snapping turtle named Tokka is on the loose.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E17 Arrgh! / Rock Bottom A pretend search for gold turns into a real treasure hunt. // SpongeBob gets on the wrong bus and finds himself lost in a mysterious part of the sea.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E18 Texas/walking Small Sandy is homesick and plans to return home. // The evil Plankton is up to no good once again when he tries to manipulate SpongeBob.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E3 Big Pink Loser/bubble Buddy Patrick goes overboard when he takes SpongeBob on as a role model. // SpongeBob blows a bubble to keep him company when Patrick goes out of town.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E4 Dying For Pie/imitation Krabs Squidward accidentally lets SpongeBob eat an exploding pie. // Plankton schemes to steal the Krabby patty by disguising himself as Mr. Krabs.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S39 E17 Sterling And Carly Aquilino Lxxxv On this episode of Ridiculousness Rob, Steelo and special guest Carly Aquilino try to jump for joy but keep having TERRIBLE TAKEOFFS, get woken up by some really stinky ALARM FARTS.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S39 E18 Sterling And Carly Aquilino Lxxxvi On Ridiculousness, Rob, Steelo, and Carly Aquilino have trouble with lights with GOT LAMPED, lose their liquor in WASTED SHOTS, and meet some kids who can't handle critters in BUG BABIES.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S39 E19 Sterling And Carly Aquilino Lxxxvii On Ridiculousness, Rob, Steelo, and Carly Aquilino take the game too seriously in ADULT LEAGUE INTENSITY, reveal far too much in SUPER HONEST, and pick up some night work in NIGHT SHIFT NIGHTMARES.

10shakeperth.au.title: Have You Been Paying Attention?

10shakeperth.au.title: Gogglebox Australia
10shakeperth.au.description: S23 E3 Episode 3 of Season 23 This time, the Goggleboxers watch One Day, Married at First Sight Australia, The Apprentice, Boarders, The Rescue, and ITV News on the energy price cap and controversial Conservative MP Lee Anderson.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Cheap Seats
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E26 Episode 26 Taking a fun look at the week that was are The Cheap Seats hosts Melanie Bracewell and Tim McDonald. Joining in on the action are Mel Tracina and Olympic skateboarder Arisa Trew.

10shakeperth.au.title: Jimmy Carr's Am I The A**hole?
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E2 A Sassy Psychic And A Saucy Phobia Jimmy Carr, GK Barry and Jamali Maddix are sniffing out potential A**holes with a controversial psychic, someone who ended a friendship over ketchup and a vengeful ex.

10shakeperth.au.title: Danny Phantom
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E9 Ultimate Enemy, Part 2 It's time for the Danny and his classmates to take their Career Aptitude Test (CAT). He's been so busy hunting ghosts that he hasn't had any time to study or think about his future.

10shakeperth.au.title: Danny Phantom
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E10 The Fright Before Christmas When Danny destroys the only copy of a Christmas story, the book's author, Ghostwriter, makes Danny hate the holiday even more by turning him into the main character of a brand new Yuletide tale.

10shakeperth.au.title: Invader Zim
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E3 The Girl Who Cried Gnome / Dibship Rising When a Girly Ranger selling cookies gets stuck in a hole in ZIM's lawn, the result is a media circus./Eager to use Tak's ship, Dib erases her personality and downloads his own.

10shakeperth.au.title: Invader Zim
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E4 Vindicated / Voting Of The Doomed Dib confides in the school psychologist, Dr. Dwicky, who believes him that Zim is an alien. Together they try to expose Zim. // Zim wants to become student body president, which his rival Dib wants to prevent at all costs.

10shakeperth.au.title: Hey Arnold!
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E6 Part Time Friends / Runaway Float Mrs. Vitello needs Arnold and Gerald to run her flower shop. // Arnold designs a fantastic float for a parade and Helga convinces her father to be the sponsor, but can Arnold bear to pay the price?

10shakeperth.au.title: Hey Arnold!
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E20 Arnold's Christmas When Arnold draws Mr. Hyunh's name in the boarding house's Secret Santa game, he decides to make it the most special Christmas for him by trying to reunite Mr. Hyunh with his long-lost daughter.

10shakeperth.au.title: T.U.F.F Puppy

abcentertains.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir - Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
abcentertains.au.description: Sorry to see their holders unlucky in love, Tikki and Plagg have made a drastic noise which is changing many a thing in Paris.for better and for worse. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: The Next Step: Cheer - Heather's Birthday Party

abcentertains.au.title: My Neighbour Totoro
abcentertains.au.description: The story follows Satsuke and Mai, two young girls who find that their new country home is in a mystical forest inhabited by a menagerie of mystical creatures called Totoros. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces - Icelandic Adventure
abcentertains.au.description: Architect George Clarke and Master Craftsman Will Hardie explore Iceland's amazing architecture, from a bauble-inspired treetop hotel room to a modernist build in the snowy wilderness and geothermal baths. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: Not Going Out - The Out-takes
abcentertains.au.description: Lee Mack, Sally Bretton and Katy Wix present a compilation of outtakes from over the series of the popular situation comedy, featuring all the bits you were never meant to see. (Comedy)

abcentertains.au.title: Midsomer Murders - A Dying Art
abcentertains.au.description: The launch of a new sculpture park is marred by murder and DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson get creative to crack a case where art imitates death. (Drama)

abcentertains.au.title: ER - True Lies
abcentertains.au.description: Morgenstern is admitted after fracturing his leg at a Scottish family reunion. Doug's family discord becomes apparent at work when he accuses an alcoholic father of neglect. Mark hesitates to tell Rachel about the divorce. (Drama)

abcentertains.au.title: Guy Montgomery's Guy Mont Spelling Bee (NZ) - I Before E, Except After F

abcentertains.au.title: QI - Advertising

abcentertains.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces - Japan, Dudley & Yorkshire Camper

abcentertains.au.title: Mythbusters

abcentertains.au.title: Portrait Artist Of The Year - David Haig, Jordan Stephens, Jane Horrocks
